Mishneh Torah, Daily Offerings and Addit: Mitzvat ase lesadder lechem happanim bechol yom shabbat al hashshulchan lifne Adonai bahechol shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 24 8)</small> "beyom hashshabbat beyom hashshabbat yaarchennu" vegomer:

Vedavar barur battora shehu shetem esre challot kol challa shene esronim. veorchin oto shene sedarim. shesh challot bechol seder. challa al gabbe challa uven kol shete challot shelosha kanim shel zahav kede shettihye haruach menashshevet bo. vesomech kol maaracha bishte kesavot. venotnin betzad kol maaracha keli sheyyesh bo kometz levona shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 24 7)</small> "venatatta al hammaarechet levona zakka". ucheli ze hu hannikra bazach. nimtzeu shene kumtze levona bishne habbezichin. veshulayim hayu labbezichin kede sheyyannichum al hashshulchan:

Shene hassedarim meakkevin ze et ze. ushene habbezichin meakkevin ze et ze. vehassedarin vehabbezichin meakkevin ze et ze. veen mechannechin et hashshulchan ella belechem happanim beshabbat. miyyom hashshabbat leyom hashshabbat motziin et hallechem shehu sham al hashshulchan mishshabbat sheavra umesadderin lechem acher. veze shemmotziin hu shecholkin shete hammishmarot hannichneset vehayyotzet im kohen gadol veochlin oto:

Vechetzad mesadderin et hallechem. arbaa kohanim nichnasim. shenayim beyadan shene sedarin. ushenayim beyadam shene bezichin. vearbaa makdimin lifnehem shenayim littol shene sedarim ushenayim littol shene bezichin shehayu sham al hashshulchan. hannichnasin omdin batztzafon ufenehem laddarom. vehayyotzin omdim baddarom ufenehem latztzafon. ellu moshchin veellu mannichin vetifcho shel ze betoch tifcho shel ze shenneemar <small>(Shemot 25 30)</small> "lefanay tamid":

Yatzu venatnu et hallechem shehotziu al shulchan zahav achar shehaya baulam vehiktiru habbezichin. veachar kach mechallekin hachallot. veim chal yom hakkippurim lihyot beshabbat hachallot mitchallekot laerev:

Ketzad maase lechem happanim. mevi arba veesrim seim chittim haruyin limnachot. veshafin otam uvoatin bahen kishar chitte menachot. vetochanin otan umenappin mehen beachat esre nafa arbaa veesrim issaron solet. veosin mehem shetem esre challot matztzot. lo nippa otam beachat esre nafa o shello hotzian meesrim vearba seim hoil venaasu solet mikkol makom kesherot. lo neemru hashshiurin haellu ella lemitzva:
Lishatan vaarichatan bachutz vaafiyyatan bifnim baazara kishar hammenachot. velashin otan achat achat. veofin otan shetayim shetayim:
Ushelosha defusin shel zahav hayu lahem. echad shennotnin bo hachalla vehi batzek. vehashsheni sheofin otah bo. vehashshelishi shennotnin otah bo kesherode otah min hattannur kede shello titkalkel:

Kol challa mehen merubbaat shenneemar <small>(Shemot 25 30)</small> "lechem happanim" sheyyihyu lo panim rabbim. orech kol challa mehen asara tefachim. verachbah chamishsha tefachim. verumah sheva etzbaot. vehashshulchan arko shenem asar tefach verachbo shishsha tefachim. noten orech hachalla al rochav hashshulchan nimtzet hachalla yotzet shene tefachim mikkan ushene tefachim mikkan. vechofel et hayyotze mikkan umikkan veyishshaer ben shene hakketzavot revach baemtza. vechen manniach challa al gabbe challa ad sheorech shesh challot. vechen ose betzad hammaaracha sheniyya shesh challot:

En afiyyat lechem happanim docha et hashshabbat velo et yom tov. ella beerev shabbat ofin otan veorchin otan lemachar. veim chalu shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana lihyot bachamishi uveerev shabbat ofin otan miyyom revii:
Lo siddur hakkanim velo netilatan doche et hashshabbat. ella meerev shabbat nichnas veshomtan venotnan leorech hashshulchan. uveechad beshabbat nichnas umachnis et hakkanim ben hachallot:

Sidder hallechem beshabbat kemitzvato velo hinniach immo beziche levona ad lemachar uleshabbat habbaa hiktir habbezichin nifsal hallechem veeno kadosh. vechen im sidder hallechem vehabbezichin beechad beshabbat vehiktir habbezichin leachar shabbat habbaa hallechem eno kadosh venifsal. aval im hiktir habbezichin beshabbat [lo] nifsal hallechem:

Ketzad yaase belechem uvezichin shessidderan leachar hashshabbat. yannichem sham al hashshulchan ad sheyyaavor alehen yom hashshabbat vehen mesuddarin. veachar kach yaktir habbezichin leshabbat habbaa achar hashshabbat sheavra alehen vehen mesuddarin. sheafillu nishar hallechem im habbezichin al hashshulchan kamma shabbatot en bechach kelum:

Sidder et hallechem veet habbezichin beshabbat kemitzvatan vehiktir et habbezichin leachar hashshabbat ben leachar shabbat zo ben leachar shabbat acheret habbaa nifsal hallechem. vahare hu kekadashim shennifselu shechayyavin alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame kemo sheyyitbaer:

Nifresa challa achat min hallechem. im ad shello hesir hallechem meal hashshulchan nifresa hallechem pasul veeno maktir alav et habbezichin. veim achar shehesir hallechem nifresa hallechem pasul umaktir alav et habbezichin:

Higgia zeman hallechem lahasiro hare ze kemi shehesiro. veim nifras hallechem maktir habbezichin veaf al pi shello perek hammaaracha. nitma echad min hassedarin ben lifne haketara ben leachar haketara o shennitma echad min habbezichin. hattame betumato vehattahor betohorato:

Seder avodot hattemidot bechol yom kach hu. samuch laalot hashshachar yavo hamemunne sheal happeyasot veyakkish al haazara ufotchin lo. umevalleshin et kol haazara. umaamidin ose chavitin laasot hachavitin. vechol hakkohanim sheshsham kevar tavlu kodem sheyyavo hamemunne velavshu bigde kehunna. veyavou veyaamdu belishkat haggazit. veyafisu payis rishon vesheni veyizke kol echad bimlachto kemo shebbearnu. umatchil ze shezzacha bitrumat haddeshen vetorem al hasseder sheamarnu. veachar kach mesadder maaracha gedola. veachar kach mesadder maaracha sheniyya. veachar kach maale shene gizre etzim umannichan al maaracha gedola leharebot haesh. veachar kach nichnasin lelishkat hakkelim umotziin kol kele hashsharet hatztzerichin lahen kol hayyom. umashkin et hattamid mayim veze shezzacha bishchitato moshcho levet hammitbachayim. veholchin acharav hakkohanim shezzachu lehaalot haevarim veshohin sham ad sheppotchin shaar hahechol haggadol. uvishat petichat hashshaar shochatin et hattamid. veachar kach nichnasin lahechol shene kohanim. haechad shezzacha bedishshun hammizbeach happenimi vehashsheni shezzacha bedishshun hammenora:
Vehamedashshen et hammizbeach medashsheno beshaa shehashshochet shochet et hattamid. veachar kach zorek haddam ze shekkibbelo:

Veachar shezzorkin et haddam metiv ze shebbahechol chamesh nerot veyotzin shenehen min hahechol. veellu shebbevet hammitbachayim mafshitin umenattechin vechol echad veechad maale evar shezzacha bo lakkevesh. venotnin haevarim mechatzi kevesh ulematta bemaaravo. veshel musafin hayu notnin otan mechatzi kevesh ulematta bemizracho. veshel rashe chodashim notnin al hammizbeach millemala ben keren lekeren bimkom hilluch ragle hakkohanim kede lefarsemo shehu rosh chodesh. umolchin sham et haevarim vezorkin melach al gabbe hakkevesh afillu beshabbat. kede shello yachlik veyippelu hakkohanim sham beet halichatan baetzim lammaaracha. veaf al pi shehammelach chotzetz ben raglehem uven hakkevesh hoil veen haholacha hazzot avoda enan choshshin:

Veachar shemmaalin haevarim lakkevesh mitkannesin kullan lelishkat haggazit. vehamemunne omer lahem barchu beracha achat. vehen potchin vekorin ahavat olam vaaseret haddibberot ushema vehaya im shamoa vayyomer veemet veyatztziv uretze vesim shalom. uveshabbat mosifin beracha achat vehi sheyyomru anshe mishmar hayyotze leanshe mishmar hannichnas. mi sheshshikken et shemo babbayit hazze yashkin benechem ahava achva shalom vereut. veachar kach mefisin payis shelishi urevii vezoche bakketoret mi shezzacha venichnas umaktir. veachar kach nichnas ze shezzacha bedishshun hammenora umetiv shete hannerot veyotze ze shehiktir im medashshen hammenora. veomed al maalot haulam hu veechav hakkohanim:

Kesheyyaggia ben haulam velammizbeach. natal echad hammagrefa uzerakah ben haulam lammizbeach. vehaya lah kol gadol. ushelosha devarim hayta meshammeshet bahen. hashshomea et kolah haya yodea sheechav hakkohanim nichnasin lehishtachavot vehu ratz uva. uven levi hashshomea et kolah haya yodea sheechav haleviyyim nichnasin ledabber beshir vehu ratz uva. verosh hammaamad keshehaya shomea et kolah haya maamid et hattemeim al shaar hammizrach mippene hachashad. sheyyedu hakkol sheadayin lo heviu kapparatan. veachar kach maale ze shezzacha baevarim et haevarim min hakkevesh lammizbeach. veachar shemmaalin et haevarim. matchilin ellu sheal maalot haulam umevarchin birkat kohanim beracha achat bashshem hameforash kemo shebbearnu bimkomah. veachar kach maalin solet hannesachim. veachar hassolet maktir hachavitin. veachar hachavitin maalin et hayyayin lenissuch. uvishat hannissuch omrin haleviyyim hashshir. umakkin hameshorrin bemine niggun shebbammikdash vetokin tesha tekiot al pirke hashshir:

Keshehayu notnin hayyayin lamnassech. hayu shene kohanim omdin al shulchan hachalavim ushete chatzotzrot beyadan. vehassegan omed al keren hammizbeach vehassudarin beyado. vetaku veheriu vetaku. uvau veamdu etzel ze hamemunne al hatztziltzal. echad mimino veechad missemolo:

Shacha hamenassech lenassech. menif hassegan besudarin. hikkish ze batztziltzal vetaku ellu bachatzotzrot vedibberu haleviyyim beshir. higgiu leferek taku vehishtachavu kol haam shebbaazara. al kol perek tekia veal kol tekia hishtachavaya. vechol hattekiot sheal hattamid tesha kemo shebbearnu:

En omrin shira ella al olot hatztzibbur vezivche shalmehem haamurin battora. aval olot nedava shemmakrivin mimmotar terumat hallishka af al pi shehen shel tzibbur en omrin shira alehen. vechen nesachim habbain bifne atzman en omrin alehen shira:

Hashshir shehayu haleviyyim omrin. bayyom harishon hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 24 1)</small> "laAdonai haaretz umeloah". bashsheni hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 48 2)</small> "gadol Adonai umehullal meod beir elohenu har kadsho" vegomer. bashshelishi hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 82 1)</small> "elohim nitztzav baadat el bekerev elohim yishpot". birvii hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 94 1)</small> "el nekamot Adonai el nekamot hofia". bachamishi hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 81 2)</small> "hareninu lelohim uzzenu hariu lelohe yaakov". bashshishshi hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 93 1)</small> "Adonai malach geut lavesh lavesh Adonai oz hitazzar" vegomer. beshabbat hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 92 1)</small> "mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat". bemusefe shabbat omrim shirat <small>(Devarim 32 1)</small> "haazinu" vecholkin otah leshishsha perakim hazziv lach kederech shekkorin otah shishsha bevet hakkeneset. veomrin perek bechol shabbat. gamru hashshira beshishsha shabbatot chozrin larosh. bemincha shel shabbat omer <small>(Shemot 15 1)</small> "az yashir mshe" u<small>(Shemot 15 11)</small> "mi chamocha" vegomer. bemusaf shel rosh hashshana hayu omrin hareninu lelohim uzzenu. veim chal lihyot bachamishi omer <small>(Tehillim 81 7)</small> "hasiroti missevel shichmo" vegomer. bemincha shel rosh hashshana hayu omrim <small>(Tehillim 29 8)</small> "kol Adonai yachil midbar" vegomer:
Rosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat shira shel rosh chodesh doche et shira shel shabbat kede lefarsem shehayyom rosh chodesh:

Beshabbat maktirin et shene beziche levona im hammusafin. kodem nissuch hayyayin shel musafin. vechasseder sheosin bechol yom babboker kach osin ben haarbayim. chutz meharamat haddeshen mimmizbeach hachitzon vesiddur hammaarachot vehappeyasot. sheen osin devarim ellu ella bechol yom bashshachar levad kemo shebbearnu:

Verashe chodashim makrivin musaf rosh chodesh achar tamid shel shachar. vechamma hu musaf rosh chodesh. parim shenayim veayil echad veshiva kevasim hakkol olot. useir izzim chattat:
Maase kol haolot echad hu kemaase hattamid. umaase hachattaot shel rashe chodashim veshel moadot kemaase hachattat hanneechelet shebbearnu:
Befesach makrivin karban musaf bechol yom. miyyom harishon ad yom hashshevii kemusaf rashe chodashim. parim shenayim veayil echad veshiva kevasim hakkol olot useir chattat hanneechelet. beyom sheni shel pesach shehu yom shishsha asar benisan makrivin yeter al musaf shel kol yom keves leola im omer hattenufa. vehi mincha shel tzibbur kemo shebbearnu:
Uzemanno kavua ulefichach doche et hashshabbat veet hattuma:
En meviin mincha zo ella meeretz yisrael shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 10)</small> "vahavetem et omer reshit ketzirchem el hakkohen". mitzvato lavo min hakkarov. lo ba min hakkarov meviin otah mikkol makom meeretz yisrael:
Mitzvato lehikkatzer ballayla belel shishsha asar. ben bechol ben beshabbat:
Vechol hallayla kasher liktzirat haomer. veim ketzaruhu bayyom kasher:
Mitzvato lavo min hakkama. lo matzu yaviu min hoomarim:
Mitzvato lavo min hallach. lo matzu yaviu min hayyavesh:
Darkan haya lehavi missadot shebbaddarom. haya nar chatzi hassade vezorea chetzyah beshana zo uveshana acheret nar chatzi hassade shezzara vezorea hachetzi shennar umevi mimmennu:
Omer ze min hasseorim haya ba. vedavar ze halacha mimmoshe rabbenu. vechetzad haya naase. meerev yom tov yotzin sheluche bet din veosin oto kerichot bimchubbar lakkarka kede sheyyihye noach liktzor. kol haayarot hassemuchot lesham mitkannesot kede sheyyihye niktzar beesek gadol. vekotzrin shalosh sein seorin bishlosha anashim. uveshalosh kuppot. uvishlosha maggalot. kevan shechashcha omer lahem hakkotzer lechol haomdim sham. ba hashshemesh omrin lo hin. ba hashshemesh omrim lo hin. ba hashshemesh omrin lo hin. maggal ze omrin lo hin. maggal ze omrin lo hin. maggal ze omrin lo hin. kuppa zo omrin lo hin. kuppa zo omrin lo hin. kuppa zo omrin lo hin. veim haya shabbat omer lahen shabbat hayyom omrim lo hin. shabbat hayyom omrin lo hin. shabbat hayyom omrin lo hin. veachar kach omer lahen ektzor vehen omrin lo ketzor. ektzor vehem omrim lo ketzor. ektzor vehem omrim lo ketzor. shalosh peamim al kol davar vedavar. vechol kach lamma mippene ellu hattoim sheyyatzu mikkelal yisrael bevayit sheni. shehen omrin shezze shenneemar battora <small>(Vayikra 23 11)</small> <small>(Vayikra 23 15 16)</small> "mimmochorat hashshabbat" hu shabbat bereshit. umippi hashshemua lamdu sheenah shabbat ella yom tov vechen rau tamid hanneviim vehassanhedrin bechol dor vedor shehayu menifin et haomer beshishsha asar benisan ben bechol ben beshabbat. vahare neemar battora <small>(Vayikra 23 14)</small> "velechem vekali vecharmel lo tochlu ad etzem hayyom hazze". veneemar <small>(Yehoshua 5 11)</small> "vayyochlu meavur haaretz mimmochorat happesach matztzot vekaluy". veim tomar sheoto happesach beshabbat era kemo sheddimmu hattippeshim. heach tala hakkatuv hetter achilatam lechadash bedavar sheeno haikkar velo hassibba ella nikra nikre. ella meachar shettala haddavar bemochorat happesach haddavar barur shemmochorat happesach hi hailla hammatteret et hechadash veen mashgichin al e ze yom hu mime hashshavua: 
Ketzaruhu unetanuhu bekuppot veheviuhu laazara vachavatuhu. vezorin uvorrin. velokchin et hasseorin umehavhavin oto baur. beabbuv menukkav. kede sheyyihye haesh sholet bechullan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2 14)</small> "aviv kaluy baesh geres karmel". mippi hashshemua lamdu sheeno medabber ella beminchat haomer bilvad. veachar shekkolin oto shotchin oto baazara veharuach menashshevet bo. venotnin oto lerechayim shel garosot vetochanin et hashshalosh sein umotziin min hakkol issaron shehu menuppe bishlosh esre nafa. vehashshear nifde veneechol lechol adam. vechayyav bechalla ufatur min hammaasrot kemo shebbearnu. velokchin ze haissaron shel solet hasseorim uvollin oto belog shemen beshishsha asar benisan venotnin alav kometz levona kishar hammenachot. umenifo bammizrach molich umevi maale umorid umaggisho keneged chuddah shel keren maaravit deromit kishar hammenachot. vekometz umaktir. vehashshear neechol lakkohanim kishyare kol hammenachot. vematay komtzin oto. leachar shemmakrivin musaf hayyom vecheves haola kodem tamid shel ben haarbayim:
Asur liktzor beeretz yisrael min mechameshet mine tevua kodem liktzirat haomer shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 10)</small> "reshit ketzirchem" sheyyihye techilla lechol hanniktzarim. bamme devarim amurim bekatzir sherauy lehavi mimmennu omer. aval bet hashshelachin shebbaamakim hoil veeno rauy lehavi mimmennu kotzrin oto millifne haomer. aval lo yigdosh:
Tevua shehishrisha kodem haomer haomer mattirah. veim lav asur lekatzrah kederech sheasur leachlah ad sheyyavo haomer habba:
Tevua shello hevia shelish muttar liktzor mimmenna lehaachil livhema. vekotzrin mippene hannetiot shello yippasdu. vekotzrin lefannot makom levet haavel o levet hammidrash. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 10)</small> "ketzirchem" velo ketzir mitzva:
Veaf al pi shemmuttar liktzor lo yaase otan kerichot kederech hakkotzrin. ella yannichem tzevatim tzevatim:
Kevar bearnu sheen meviin menachot velo minchat nesachim velo bikkurim min hechadash kodem havaat haomer. veim hevi pasul. velo yavi kodem lahavaat shete hallechem. veim hevi kasher:
Vechol hammakriv mincha min hechadash techilla mevarech shehecheyaynu:
Tevua shezzeraah achar shekkarav haomer uketzarah achar shekkarav haomer shel shana habbaa hare zo safek im meviin mimmenna menachot lechattechilla terem havaat shete hallechem hoil utevua zo avar aleha havaat shete hallechem uketzirat haomer. o en meviin ad sheyyaviu shete hallechem achar havaat haomer shel shana acheret:
Vechen tevua shehayta bakkarka vechantu aleha o henetztzu alim shellah kesheheviu shete hallechem hare ze safek im hanatzat healin o chanatatan kemo hushresha vehuttera lehavi mimmenna menachot o enah chashuva hasherasha. lefichach lo yavi veim hevi hurtza:
Vehakkotzer kodem ketzirat haomer eno loke vehakkatzir kasher:
Mitzvat ase lispor sheva shabbatot temimot miyyom havaat haomer shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 15)</small> "usefartem lachem mimmochorat hashshabbat" "sheva shabbatot". umitzva limnot hayyamim im hashshavuot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 16)</small> "tisperu chamishshim yom". umittechillat hayyom monin lefichach mone ballayla millel shishsha asar benisan: 
Shachach velo mana ballayla mone bayyom veen monin ella meummad. veim mana meyushshav yatza:
Mitzva zo al kol ish miyyisrael uvechol makom uvechol zeman. venashim vaavadim peturin mimmenna:
Vetzarich levarech bechol layla baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam asher kidshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al sefirat haomer kodem sheyyispor. mana velo berech yatza veeno chozer umevarech:

Beyom chamishshim missefirat haomer. hu chag hashshavuot. vehu atzeret. uvayyom hazze makrivin musaf kemo musaf rosh chodesh shene parim veayil veshiva kevasim kullam olot useir chattat. veellu hen hakkarbanot haamurot bechummash happekudim vehem musaf hayyom. veod meviin yeter al hammusaf bayyom hazze mincha chadasha shete hallechem umakrivin im hallechem par ushene elim veshiva kevasim. hakkol olot. useir chattat. ushene kevasim zevach shelamim. veellu hen hakkarbanot haamurot bechummash vayyikra. nimtza hakkarev beyom ze yeter al shene hattemidin shelosha parim ushelosha elim vearbaa asar kevasim. hakkol esrim behema olot. ushene seire chattaot neechalim. ushene kevasim shelamim neechalim:
Shete hallechem enan bain ella min haaretz umin hechadash shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 17)</small> "mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa" vegomer. lo matzu chadash yaviu min haaliyya:

Chittim sheyyardu beavim yesh bahem safek im ani kore bahem <small>(Vayikra 23 17)</small> "mimmoshvotechem" o enam mimmoshvotechem lefichach lo yavi veim hevi kasher. vechetzad hayu osin. meviin shalosh sein chittin chadashot veshafin otan uvoatin bahem kederech kol hammenachot vetochanin otan solet umenappin mehen shene esronot menuppe bishtem esre nafa vehashshear nifde veneechol lechol adam. vechayyav bechalla ufatur min hammaasrot kemo shebbearnu:

Shete hallechem shehen min hechadash tzerichin lavo issaron mikkol sea umechetza umenappin otan bishtem esre nafa. velechem happanim shehu ba min hayyashan day lo beachat esre nafa vehu ba issaron mikkol sea. aval haomer shehu ba min hasseorim chadashot eno ba min hammuvchar ella mishshalosh sein uvishlosh asara nafa:
Vechullam im ribba bemiddat hassein shebbain mehen o miet kasher:
Velokchin shene haesronot velashin otan achat achat veofin otan achat achat:
Velishatan vaarichatan bachutz vaafiyyatan bifnim kechol hammenachot:
Veen asiyyatan docha yom tov veen tzarich lomar shabbat ella ofin otan meerev yom tov shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 16)</small> "hu levaddo yease lachem" lachem velo legavoah:

Haya erev yom tov shabbat ofin otan meerev shabbat veneechalot bashshelishi laafiyyatan shehu yom tov. vahare meforash battora shehem chametz. vechetzad ose. mevi seor mimmakom acher venotno letoch haissaron umemalle haissaron solet umechammetzo beoto hasseor:
Umerubbaot hen. orech kol challa shiva tefachim verachbah arbaa tefachim vegavhah arba etzbaot:

Ketzad hanafat hallechem im shene kivse hashshelamim. mevi shene hakkevasim umenifam beodan chayyim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 12)</small> "vehenif otam tenufa". veim henif ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo yatza. veachar kach shochatin otan umafshit. velokeach chaze veshok mikkol echad mishshenehem umannichan betzad shete hallechem umeniach shete yadav millemattan umenif hakkol keechad bammizrach bimkom kol hattenufot. molich umevi. maale umorid. veim henifan echad echad yatza. veachar kach maktir emure shene hakkevasim ushear habbasar neechol lakkohanim. vechen shete hachallot notel kohen gadol achat mehen. vehashsheniyya mitchalleket lechol hammishmarot. ushetehen neechalot oto hayyom vachatzi hallayla kivsar kadshe kadashim:

Shachat shene kevasim al arba challot. im amar yikkadshu shetayim mittoch arba moshech shetayim mehen umenifan. vehashshear podin otan bifnim veneechalin bachutz kishar hachullin. veim lo hitna lo kadash hallechem:
Shachat arbaa kevasim al shete challot. moshech shenayim mehem vezorek daman shello lishman. umenif hashshenayim hannisharim hakkesherim im shete hallechem:
Shete hachallot meakkevot zo et zo. ushene hakkevasim meakkevin ze et ze. met echad mishshenehem o barach o naasa terefa. yikkach zug lesheni. shachat echad lishmo. yikkach lo zug:

Shete hallechem meakkevim et hakkevasim. ushene hakkevasim enan meakkevim et hallechem. veim hunefu im hakkevasim meakkevin ze et ze. veim avad hallechem yovdu hakkevasim veim avdu hakkevasim yovdu hallechem veyaviu lechem acher uchevasim acherim:

Shete hallechem habbaot bifne atzman belo kevasim ketzad osin bahen. yunefu uteubbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa gezera shemma yimtzeu kevasim leshana habbaa veyaviu lechem belo kevasim. happar ushene haelim veshivat hakkevasim vehassair habbaim beyom ze biglal hallechem enan meakkevin et hallechem velo hallechem meakkevan:
Shene parim shel musaf hayyom ufar habba biglal hallechem enan meakkevin ze et ze:
Ayil shel musaf hayyom ushene elim habbain biglal hallechem enan meakkevin (ze et ze):
Shiva kevasim shel musaf hayyom veshiva kevasim habbaim biglal hallechem enan meakkevin ze et ze. veim nishchatu kullan meakkevin ze et ze:

Hattemidin enam meakkevin et hammusafin velo hammusafin meakkevin et hattemidin velo hammusafin meakkevin ze et ze velo minyan haolot kullan meakkev. ketzad. hare shello matzu ella shishsha kevasim makrivin shishsha afillu lo matzu ella echad makrivin oto ben berashe chodashim ben bime hammoadot vehashshabbatot. veenan chayyavin lehakeriv hashshear lemachar o lemoed acher ella kol karban tzibbur sheavar zemanno batel karbano. lo matzu ella shene kevasim im yakrivu otan lemusaf hayyom en lahen temidin lemachar. hare haddavar shakul im hikrivum lemusaf hayyom hikrivu veim ratzu lehannicham lemachar litmidin yannichu:

Beechad betishre makrivin musaf hayyom par veayil veshiva kevasim hakkol olot useir chattat hanneechelet. veze musaf hayyom yeter al musaf rosh chodesh hakkarev bechol rosh chodesh. lefichach im chal lihyot beshabbat hayu sham shelosha musafin musaf shabbat umusaf rosh chodesh umusaf hayyom:

Vechetzad siddur hakeravatan. musaf shabbat techilla veacharav musaf hachodesh veacharav musaf yom tov. shekkol hattadir mechavero kodem et chavero vechen kol hamekuddash mechavero kodem et chavero. haya lefanav tadir umekuddash yakdim eze mehem sheyyirtze:
Avar o shachach veshachat et sheeno tadir o happachut bikdushsha techilla makrivo veachar kach shochet et hattadir o et hamekuddash:
Veim nishchatu shenehem keechad yihye ze memares baddam ad sheyyizrok dam hattadir o dam hamekuddash:

Dam hachattat kodem ledam haola mippene sheddam hachattat mechapper. evre ola kodmin leemure chattat mippene shehaola kullah laishshim. dam chattat veevre ola e ze sheyyirtze yakdim. vechen dam ola veemure chattat o dam ola vedam asham e ze sheyyirtze yakdim:

Chattat kodemet leola afillu chattat haof kodemet leolat behema shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 8)</small> "et asher lachattat rishona" binyan av lechol chattat shehi kodemet leola habba immah. vechen bishat haferasha mafrish hachattat techilla veachar kach haola:

Bekarbenot hechag eno chen ella kerevin al seder hakkatuv shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 29 6)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 29 33)</small> "kemishpatam". ketzad. battechilla parim. veacharehem elim. veacharehem kevasim. veacharehem seirim. af al pi shehasseirim chattat vechol ellu shekkadmu otan olot. vechen beshiggat tzibbur baavoda zara shehen meviin par ola vesair chattat. happar kodem shenneemar bo <small>(Bamidbar 15 24)</small> "kammishpat". ufar kohen mashiach kodem lefar helem davar shel tzibbur. ufar helem kodem lefar avoda zara. ufar avoda zara kodem lesair shellah. af al pi shehappar ola vehassair chattat. shekkach hu seder hakkatuv battora. seir avoda zara kodem lisir nasi shehannasi yachid. useir nasi kodem lisirat yachid. useirat yachid kodemet lechavsa. af al pi sheshshenehem chattat. shehasseira reuya lavo al hakkeretot shemmeviin alehem chattat. vehakkavsa enah baa al shiggat avoda zara:

Afillu chattat haof shel yoledet kodemet lechavsa. chattat kodemet leasham mippene sheddamah nittan al arba keranot veal hayesod. vechol chattaot shebbattora kodmin lechol haashamot. chutz measham metzora mippene shehu ba al yede hechsher. haasham kodem letoda uleel nazir mippene shehu kadshe kadashim. toda veel nazir kodmin lishlamim mippene shehen neechalin leyom echad uteunin lechem. vehattoda kodemet leel nazir mippene sheyyesh bah arbaa mine mincha. shelamim kodmin livchor mippene shehen teunin mattan shetayim shehen kearba uteunin semicha utenufa unesachim. habbechor kodem lemasar behema mippene shekkedushshato merechem veneechol lakkohanim bilvad. hammaaser kodmin leofot mippene shehu zevach veyesh bo kadshe kadashim damo veemurav. vehaofot kodmin limnachot mippene shehen mine damim. hare shehayu lefanav chattat haof umaaser. hammaaser kodem mippene shehu zevach. hayu sham chattat haof umaaser veolat behema hoil veola kodemet lemaaser vechattat haof kodemet leolat behema makriv chattat haof techilla veachar kach haola veachar kach hammaaser:

Hare shehayu mine behema harebe mimmin karban echad ketzad hen kerevin. happarim kodmin leelim shekken nitrabbu binsachim. veelim kodmin lichvasim shekken nitrabbu binsachim. uchevasim kodmin lisirim shekken nitrabbu beemurim. shebbichlal emure kevasim haalya veen bisirim alya. haomer kodem lakkeves habba immo. ushete hallechem kodmin lishne kevasim. ze hakkelal davar habba biglal hayyom kodem ledavar habba biglal hallechem:

Minchat haish kodemet leminchat haishsha. minchat chittim kodemet leminchat seorim. minchat chote kodemet leminchat nedava mippene shehi baa al chet. minchat nedava uminchat sota e zo sheyyirtze mehem yakdim:

Menachot kodmin layyayin. vehayyayin kodem lashshemen. vehashshemen kodem lallevona. ulevona kodemet lammelach. umelach kodem laetzim. ematay bizman shebbau kullan keechad. aval habba rishon karev rishon vehabba acharon karev acharon:
Kol hakkodem behakerava kodem baachila:

Hayu lefanav shelamim shel emesh ushelamim shel yom. shel emesh kodmin shehare karav zemannan. shelamim shel emesh vechattat o asham shel yom. chattat veasham kodmin mippene shehen kadshe kadashim kemo shebbearnu:

Beyom hakkippurim makrivin musaf kemusaf rosh hashshana par veayil. veayil ze nikra el haam. veshiva kevasim kullan olot. useir chattat vehu neechol laerev:
Veod makrivin hatztzibbur seir chattat vehu nisraf shebben zugo sair hammishtalleach:
Bayyom harishon shel chag hassukkot makrivin musaf hayyom shelosha asar parim ushene elim vearbaa asar kevasim kullan olot useir chattat neechelet. vechen kol yom veyom mishshivat yeme hechag makrivin shene elim vearbaa asar kevasim useir chattat:
Aval happarim pochatin echad echad bechol yom. bashsheni makrivin shenem asar. bashshelishi achad asar. ad sheyyimmatze karban yom shevii parim shiva elim shenayim kevasim arbaa asar hakkol olot useir chattat:
Bayyom hashshemini atzeret makrivin musaf hayyom par veayil veshiva kevasim kullan olot useir chattat. veze musaf bifne atzmo:
Kol shivat yeme hechag menassechin et hammayim al gabbe hammizbeach. vedavar ze halacha lemoshe missinay. veim nissuch hayyayin shel tamid shel shachar haya menassech hammayim levaddo:
Veim era hammayim letoch hayyayin o hayyayin letoch hammayim venissech shenehem mikkeli echad yatza. veim hikdim nissuch hammayim lazevach afillu nissechan ballayla yatza. uvekeren deromit maaravit haya menassech lemala mechatzi hammizbeach vehakkol yored lashshitin kemo shebbearnu. ketzad hayu osin. tzelochit shel zahav machzeket shelosha login haya memalle otah min hashshiloach. higgiu leshaar hammayim taku veheriu vetaku. ala lakkevesh ufana lismolo venoten hammayim min hatztzelochit letoch hassefel shehaya sham. ushene sefalim shel kesef hayu sham. maaravi haya bo hammayim. umizrachi haya bo hayyayin shel nesech. vehayu menukkavin kemin shene chotamin dakkin. veshel mayim haya nekev shello dak mishshel yayin kede sheyyichle hammayim im hayyayin keechad:
Ze shemmenassech hammayim hayu omrin lo hagebeah yadcha. sheppaam achat nissech echad al raglav uregamuhu kol haam beetrogehen sheamru tzedoki hu shehen omrin en menassechin mayim:
Kemaasehu bechol kach maasehu beshabbat. ella shehaya memalle meerev shabbat chavit shel zahav veenah mikkele hashsharet umannichah ballishka ulemachar memalle mimmenna:
Im nishpecha o nitgalleta memalle min hakkiyyor umenassech:
Bechol yom veyom mime hechag hayu omrim shira bifne atzmah al musaf hayyom. barishon mime chullo shel moed hayu omrin <small>(Tehillim 29 1)</small> "havu laAdonai bene elim". bashsheni <small>(Tehillim 50 16)</small> "velarasha amar elohim" vegomer. bashshelishi <small>(Tehillim 94 16)</small> "mi yakum li im mereim". barvii <small>(Tehillim 94 8)</small> "binu boarim baam" vegomer. bachamishi <small>(Tehillim 81 7)</small> "hasiroti missevel shichmo". bashshishshi <small>(Tehillim 82 5)</small> "yimmotu kol mosde aretz" vegomer. veim chal shabbat lihyot beechad mehen yimmotu yiddache: 
Kevar bearnu shekkol mishmerot kehunna esrim vearbaa. vechullan ovdin beshave bargalim. uvechag hassukkot haya kol mishmar makriv par echad o ayil echad o seir hachattat. aval hakkevasim yesh mishmar shemmakriv mehen shene kevasim. veyesh mishmar shemmakriv keves echad. ketzad. beyom tov harishon shel chag hayu sham shelosha asar parim ushene elim vesair. kol mishmar makriv behema achat mehem. nisharu sham arbaa asar kevasim lishmone mishmarot. shishsha mishmarot makrivin shenayim shenayim ushene mishmarot makrivin echad echad. bashsheni hayu sham shenem asar parim ushene elim vesair. kol mishmar makriv echad. nisharu sham arbaa asar kevasim letisha mishmarot. chamishsha makrivin shenayim shenayim. vearbaa makrivin echad echad. bashshelishi hayu sham achad asar parim ushene elim vesair. kol mishmar makriv echad. nisharu arbaa asar kevasim laasara mishmarot. arbaa makrivin shenayim shenayim veshishsha makrivin echad echad. barvii hayu sham asara parim ushene elim vesair. kol mishmar makriv echad. nisharu sham arbaa asar kevasim leachad asar mishmar. shelosha makrivin shenayim shenayim ushemona makrivin echad echad. bachamishi hayu sham tisha parim ushene elim vesair. kol mishmar makriv echad. nisharu sham arbaa asar kevasim lishnem asar mishmar. shene mishmarot makrivin shenayim shenayim vaasara makrivin echad echad. bashshishshi hayu shemona parim ushene elim vesair. kol mishmar makriv echad. nisharu sham arbaa asar kevasim lishlosha asar mishmar. mishmar echad mehen makriv shene kevasim ushenem asar mishmar makrivin echad echad. bashshevii hayu sham shiva parim ushene elim vesair. vearbaa asar kevasim keminyan hammishmarot. nimtza kol mishmar makriv behema achat:
Vechol mi shehaya makriv par hayyom lo haya makriv par lemachar ella chozrin chalila. bashshemini chozrin lefayis kullan keechad kishar hargalim kemo shebbearnu:
Beyom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat haya sham minchat nesachim shel musafin veshel temidin shishshim veechad issaron velo hayu mearvin oto:
Uleolam en mearvin nesachim. ella niske happarim levaddam veniske haelim levaddam veniske kevasim levaddam. ben bekarbenot tzibbur ben bekarbenot yachid:
Vechol hachalavim shel karbanot ben karbenot tzibbur ben karbenot yachid en mearvin otan ze baze ella maktirin emure kol karban vekarban bifne atzmo. veim nitarvu maktir hakkol keechad:
Menachot shel nesachim shennitarvu zo bazo achar shennivlal kol min umin bifne atzmo kesherot:
Vechevan shennivlelu hammenachot venitarev shamnan vesaltan hare ze muttar learev yayin shellahen lechattechilla. vechen im hiktir menachot shel nesachim kol achat veachat bifne atzmah hare ze muttar learev hayyayin shellahen:
Keshemmearvin hayyayin shel nesachim yesh lo learev yen nesachim shel emesh beshel yom veshel yachid beshel tzibbur. ucheshemmearev mearev yen niske parim beyen niske elim yen niske kevasim beyen niske kevasim. aval en mearvin yen niske kevasim beyen niske parim veelim:
Uleolam en mearvin hayyayin lechattechilla ella achar shennitarva hassolet o achar shehiktiru kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 1: Kol nefesh chayya shehi birshuto shel adam shehizzika habbealim chayyavin leshallem shehare mamonam hizzik shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 la)</small> "chi yiggof shor ish et shor reehu". echad hashshor veechad shear behema chayya veof. lo dibber hakkatuv beshor ella bahove:

Vechamma meshallem. im hizzika bidvarim sheddarkah laasotam tamid keminhag beriyyatah. kegon behema sheachla teven o amir o shehizzika beraglah bederech hilluchah chayyav leshallem nezek shalem min hayyafe shebbinchasav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 4)</small> "metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem". veim shinneta veasta maasim sheen darkah laasotam tamid vehizzika bahen. kegon shor shennagach o nashach. chayyav leshallem chatzi nezek migguf hammazzik atzmo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 la)</small> "umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo" vegomer:

Ketzad. shor shave mane shennagach leshor shave esrim vehemito vahare hannevela shava arbaa baal hashshor chayyav leshallem shemono shehu chatzi hannezek. veeno chayyav leshallem ella migguf hashshor shehizzik shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 la)</small> "umachru et hashshor hachay". lefichach im hemit shor shave esrim leshor shave matayim vehannevela shava mane en baal hannevela yachol lomar levaal hachay ten li chamishshim. ella omer lo hare shor shehizzik lefanecha kachehu velech afillu eno shave ella dinar. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Haose maase sheddarko laasoto tamid keminhag beriyyato hu hannikra muad. vehameshanne veasa maase sheen derech kol mino laasot ken tamid kegon shor shennagach o nashach hu hannikra tam. veze hameshanne im hirgil beshinnuyo peamim rabbot naasa muad leoto davar shehirgil bo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 36)</small> "o noda ki shor naggach hu":

Chamishsha maasim tamim yesh bivhema. veim huada leechad mehen naaset muedet leoto maase. veellu hen. habbehema enah muedet mittechillatah lo liggach velo liggof velo lishshoch velo lirbotz al kelim gedolim velo livot. veim huada leechad mehen hare zo muedet lo. aval hashshen muedet mittechillatah leechol et harauy lah. veharegel muedet mittechillatah lishbor bederech hilluchah. vehabbehema muedet mittechillatah lirbotz al pakkin ketannim vechayyotze bahem velimoch otan:

Chamishsha mine behema muadin mittechillat beriyyatan lehazzik vaafillu hen bene tarbut. lefichach im hizziku o hemitu bingicha o binshicha uderisa vechayyotze bahen chayyav nezek shalem. veellu hen. hazzeev vehaari vehaddov vehannamer vehabbardelas. vechen hannachash shennashach hare ze muad vaafillu haya ben tarbut:

Kol muad meshallem nezek shalem min hayyafe shebbinchasav. vechol tam meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo. bamme devarim amurim beshennichnesa habbehema lirshut hannizzak vehizzikathu. aval im nichnas hannizzak lirshut hammazzik vehizzikathu behemto shel baal habbayit hare ze patur al hakkol. shehare hu omer lo illu lo nichnasta lirshuti lo higgia lecha hezzek vahare meforash battora <small>(Shemot 22 4)</small> "veshillach et beiro uvier bisde acher":

Hizzika birshut harabbim o bechatzer sheenah shel shenehen lo lammazzik velo lannizzak o bechatzer shehi shel shenehen vahare hi meyuchedet lehanniach bah perot ulehachnis lah behema kegon habbika vechayyotze bah. im beshen veregel hizzika kedarkah hare ze patur mippene sheyyesh lah reshut lehallech [kan] vechan vederech habbehema lehallech veleechol kedarkah velishbor bederech hilluchah. veim nagcha o nagfa o ravtza o baata o nashcha. im tamma hi meshallem chatzi nezek veim muedet nezek shalem:

Hayta hechatzer shel shenehen meyuchedet leferot velo lehachenis bah behema vehichnis sham echad min hashshuttafin behemto vehizzika chayyav afillu al hashshen veal haregel. vechen im hayta meyuchedet livhema lishnehem vehaya reshut laechad mehen bilvad lehachenis lah perot vehizzika perotav chayyav al hashshen veal haregel:

Shelosha avot nezikin beshor. hakkeren vehashshen veharegel. toldot hakkeren negifa neshicha revitza beita. toldot hashshen im nitchakkecha bechotel lahanaatah vehizzika bechikkuchah. vechen im tinnefa perot lahanaatah. toldot haregel hizzika begufah derech hilluchah o shehizzika bisarah derech hilluchah o kishkesha biznavah o baukkaf shealeha bapperumebya shebbefiha bazzog shebbetzavvarah. vechen chamor shehizzik bemassao bishat hillucho veegla hammoshechet bekaron shehizzika bishat meshichatah. kol ellu toldot haregel hen uvirshut harabbim peturin uvirshut hannizzak meshallemin nezek shalem:

Kishkesha biznavah kishkush rav sheen darkah laasotah tamid vehizzika birshut harabbim. o shekkishkesha baggid shellah birshut harabbim vehizzika. patur. veim tafas hannizzak gove chatzi nezek mimma shettafas. shezze haddavar safek hu im ellu toldot hakkeren shechayyav aleha birshut harabbim o toldot haregel sheppatur aleha birshut harabbim kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 2: Echad avot nezikin veechad hattoladot im haya haav muad toldotav muadot veim haya tam toldotav kamohu. vechol avot nezikin vechol toldotehen muadin hen mittechillatan chutz mikkeren vetoldotav shehen tamim battechilla ad sheyyuadu kemo shebbearnu:

Kol tolada keav shellah chutz mitztzerorot hamenattezin mittachat ragle habbehema bishat hilluchah. sheaf al pi shettoledet haregel hem ufatur alehen birshut harabbim keregel veim hizziku birshut hannizzak meshallem min hayyafe shebbinchasav keregel shehu av af al pi chen eno meshallem ella chatzi nezek:

Ketzad. behema shennichnesa lachatzar hannizzak vehalcha vehayu tzerorot menattezin mittachat ragleha veshavru et hakkelim meshallem chatzi nezek min hayyafe shebbinchasav. vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala hi:

Vechen im hayta mehallechet birshut harabbim venittezu tzerorot mittachat ragleha lirshut hannizzak veshavru et hakkelim meshallem chatzi nezek. darsa al hakkeli birshut hannizzak ushevarattu venafal al keli acher ushevaro. al harishon meshallem nezek shalem veal haacharon meshallem chatzi nezek:

Hayta mehallechet birshut harabbim uvaata vehittiza tzerorot vehizziku birshut harabbim patur. veim tafas hannizzak revia nezek en motziin miyyado. shehaddavar safek hu shemma shinnuy hu veeno toledet regel shehare baata:

Baata baaretz birshut hannizzak vehittiza tzerorot mechamat habbeita vehizziku sham chayyav leshallem revia nezek shezze shinnuy hu behattazat hatztzerorot. veim tafas hannizzak chatzi nezek en motziin miyyado. vaafillu hayta mehallechet bemakom shei efshar lah shello tattiz uvaata vehittiza meshallem revia nezek. veim tafas hannizzak chatzi nezek en motziin miyyado:

Kol hameshallem nezek shalem hare hattashlumin mamon shehu chayyav leshallemo kemi shellava mechavero shehu chayyav leshallem. vechol hameshallem chatzi nezek hare hattashlumin kenas chutz mechatzi nezek shel tzerorot shehu halacha kemo shebbearnu:

Ze hakkelal kol hameshallem ma shehizzik hare ze mamon vechol hameshallem yeter o pachot kegon tashlume kefel o chatzi nezek hare hayyater al hakkeren o happachot kenas. veen chayyavin kenas ella al pi edim. aval hammode bechol kenas min hakkenasot patur:

Tarnegol shehoshit rosho laavir keli zechuchit vetaka bo ushevaro. im hayu betocho tavlin vechayyotze bahen shehoshit rosho kede leachlan. al hattavlin meshallem nezek shalem veal hakkeli meshallem chatzi nezek kachatzi nezek tzerorot shekkach hu darko. veim haya hakkeli rekan hare ze meshunne umeshallem chatzi nezek kechol hakkenasot:

Vechen sus shetztzanaf vachamor shennaar veshavar et hakkelim meshallem chatzi nezek. hattarnegolin muadin lehallech kedarkan uleshabber. haya chut o retzua kashur beraglehen venistabbech keli beoto hachut venitgalgel venishbar meshallem chatzi nezek. bamme devarim amurim keshekkesharo adam. aval im nikshar al raglehem meelav baal hattarnegolin patur. veim hayu lachut bealim velo haya hachut hefker baal hachut chayyav chatzi nezek shehare hu kevor hammitgalgel:
Hitznia baal hachut et hachut vehattarnegolim darsu alav vehotziuhu venikshar beraglehen veshavru bo et hakkelim af baal hachut patur shehare anus hu:
Tarnegolin shehayu mafrichin mimmakom lemakom veshavru et hakkelim. im bechanfehem shavru meshallem nezek shalem veim baruach shebbechanfehem meshallem chatzi nezek:
Hayu mehaddesin al gabbe issa o al gabbe perot vetinnefu o nikkeru meshallemin nezek shalem. hizziku beafar o bitzrorot sheheelu bechanfehen o beraglehen meshallemin chatzi nezek:

Hayu mechattetin bechevel venifsak hachevel venishbar haddeli meshallemin nezek shalem. vehu shennitgalgel haddeli mechamatan ad shennafal venishbar. veim haya al hachevel ochel uvaet achilatan pesakuhu meshallem gam al hachevel nezek shalem:

Hakkelev vehaggedi shekkaftzu merosh haggag millemala lematta veshavru et hakkelim meshallemin nezek shalem mippene shemmuadim hen ledavar ze. vechen im naflu vehizziku. shealiyyatan lerosh haggag peshia. veaf al pi shennefilatan ones kol shettechillato bifshia vesofo beones chayyav:

Kaftzu mimmatta lemala meshallemin chatzi nezek. vehu shennitlash haggedi venisrach vekafatz hakkelev. aval nisrach hakkelev vedilleg haggedi ben millemala lematta ben mimmatta lemala chayyavin nezek shalem. vechen tarnegol sheddilleg ben millemala lematta ben millematta lemala meshallem nezek shalem:

Kelev shennatal et hacharara vehalach lo laggadish. im hinnichah baggadish veachal et hacharara vehidlik et haggadish al hacharara veal mekom hacharara meshallem nezek shalem veal shear haggadish chatzi nezek. veim haya megarer et hacharara al haggadish veholech vesoref meshallem al hacharara nezek shalem veal mekom haggechalim chatzi nezek veal shear haggadish patur:

Bamme devarim amurim besheshshamar baal haggachelet et ishsho vesatam haddelet uva hakkelev vechatar venatal et hacharara meal haesh. aval im lo shamar ishsho baal haesh chayyav al serefat haggadish uvaal hakkelev chayyav al achilat hacharara veal mekomah:

Hameshasse kalbo shel chavero bachavero patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim uvaal hakkelev chayyav chatzi nezek shekkevan shehu yodea sheim shissa et kalbo lehazzik noshech lo haya lo lehannicho. veim shissahu beatzmo baal hakkelev patur shekkol hameshanne uva acher veshinna bo patur:
Shete parot birshut harabbim achat revutza veachat mehallechet uvaata mehallechet birvutza chayyav chatzi nezek sheaf al pi sheddarkah lehallech aleha en darkah livot bah:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 3:
Habbehema muedet leechol perot o yerakot vechayyotze bahen. lefichach im nichnesa lirshut hannizzak veachla devarim sheddarkah leachlam meshallem nezek shalem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 4)</small> "uvier bisde acher metav sadehu" vegomer. veim achalatam birshut harabbim patur. veim nehenet meshallem ma shennehenet lo ma shehizzika: 
Ketzad. nichnesa lirshut hannizzak veachla shumshemin o lot vechayyotze bahem bishve dinar meshallem dinar. veim achalatan birshut harabbim venehenet roin otan keillu hen seorim o amir umeshallem deme amir o deme seorim bezol: 
Achla ochalin haraim lah kegon sheachla chittin hoil velo nehenet patur. achla ochalin sheen darkah leachlan kegon sheachla kesut o kelim ben birshut hannizzak ben birshut harabbim meshallem chatzi nezek shezze shinnuy hu vederech bene adam lehanniach kelehem uchesutan birshut harabbim ad sheyyanuchu meat: 
Behema shehayta omedet birshut hannizzak vetalsha perot mershut harabbim vaachalatan birshut hannizzak hare haddavar safek lefichach enah meshallemet ella ma shennehenet. veim tafas hannizzak kamma shehizzika en motziin miyyado shehare birshuto achla: 
Kelev shennichnas lechatzer venatal pat o basar vehotzian lirshut harabbim o lechatzer acheret vaachalam ma shennehena meshallem. achalam bassade shel baal hechatzer meshallem nezek shalem keillu achalan betoch hechatzer shehare birshut hannizzak achal. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Behema sheachla ochalin sheen darkah leachlan aval ochaltan al yede haddechak. kegon para sheachla seorim vachamor sheachal karshinim o dagim vachazir sheachal chaticha basar vechelev shellikkek et hashshemen vechatul sheachal temarim. vechen kol kayyotze beellu. im achalah birshut hannizzak meshallem nezek shalem. uvirshut harabbim patur veim nehenet meshallem ma shennehenet: 
Chayya shennichnesa lirshut hannizzak vetarfa veachla behema o basar meshallem nezek shalem shezzehu darkah. aval kelev sheachal kevasim ketannim o chatul sheachal tarnegolim gedolim hare ze shinnuy umeshallem chatzi nezek: 
Sal sheyyesh bo lechem venichnas chamor veshavar hassal veachal hallechem meshallem al hassal veal hallechem nezek shalem shezze hu darko. vechen seir izzim sheraa lefet vechayyotze bo al pi hechavit venistabbech bechavit veachal et hallefet veshavar et hechavit meshallem al shenehem nezek shalem. keshem sheddarko leechol kach darko lehittalot bechelim velaalot kede leechol. vechen kol kayyotze baze. aval im nichnas hachamor veachal et hallechem veachar kach shavar et hassal al hallechem meshallem nezek shalem veal hassal chatzi nezek. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Behema sheachla mittoch harchava ben derech halichatah ben sheamda veachla meshallem ma shennehenet vaafillu chazra al tzidde harchava veachla mehen. aval im hinnicha et harchava vehalcha veamda betzidde harchava veachla meshallem ma shehizzika. achla mippetach hachanut meshallem ma shennehenet. mittoch hachanut meshallem ma shehizzika: 
Hayta mehallechet birshut harabbim ufashta tzavvarah veachla meal gabbe chavertah vaafillu amda meshallem ma shennehenet shekken derech habbehemot leechol zo meal gabbe zo. veim kaftza veachla al gabbe chavertah meshallem ma shehizzika sheggabbe chavertah kachatzar hannizzak hu chashuv: 
Behema shehuchleka beeven o bememe ragleha venafla leginna venechbeta al gabbe perot virakot o sheachla meshallem ma shennehenet. afillu halcha mearuga laaruga vaafillu nishara sham kol hayyom kullo eno meshallem ella ma shennehenet. uma hanaa yesh lah bachavita shehare matza makom rach velo nitrasseku evareha. aval im yarda kedarkah veachla meshallem ma shehizzika. vaafillu tinnefa perot beme leda meshallem ma shehizzika mippene shettechillato bifshia. vechen im dechafatah chavertah venafla meshallem ma shehizzika mippene shehaya lo lehaaviran achat achat kede shello yidchafu zo et zo: 
Huchleka venafla veyatzat vechazra lagginna af al pi shechazra shello ledaat habbealim meshallem ma shehizzika mippene shehaya lo leshamrah shello tachzor shehaddavar yadua shekkevan sheyyada derech hagginna hare hi chozeret meeleha: 
Hakkaddar shehichnis kederotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut ushevaratan behemto shel baal habbayit patur. veim huzzeka bahen baal hakkederot chayyav. veim hichnis birshut patur. veim kibbel alav baal habbayit lishmor et hakkederot baal habbayit chayyav: 
Vechen im hichnis perotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut vaachalatam behemto shel baal habbayit patur. veim huchleka bahen vehuzzeka baal happerot chayyav. veim hichnis birshut patur. veim kibbel alav baal habbayit lishmor et happerot baal habbayit chayyav. hichnisan shello birshut vaachalatan behemto shel baal habbayit vehuzzeka baachilatan baal happerot patur mippene shehaya lah shello tochal. veim hichnisah birshut vehinnichu baale hechatzer et ze shehirshahu bechatzer leshamro vaachalatan behemto shel baal habbayit vehuzzeka baachilatan baal happerot chayyav. shekkevan sheraa habbehema ochelet devarim hammazzikin lah vehinnichah chayyav shehare en baale hechatzer metzuyin sham lehaavir habbehema mehen. umaase beishsha shennichnesa leefot battannur bevet shechenoteha vehinnichuha venitallemu kede shello yabbitu bah beet lishatah vaafiyyatah uva ez shel baal habbayit veachal habbatzek umet vechiyyevuha chachamim leshallem damav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hammagdish betoch sede chavero shello birshut vaachalatan behemto shel baal hassade patur. veim huchleka bahen vehuzzeka baal happerot chayyav. achalatan vehuzzeka baachilatan patur. veim higgedish birshut baal hassade chayyav af al pi shello kibbel alav lishmor. shehashshomer bogoranot kevan sheamar lo hagedesh bechan kemi sheamar lo hagedesh vaani eshmor lecha hu chashuv:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 4:
Hakkonnes tzon laddir venaal bifnehen bedelet sheyyechola laamod beruach metzuya veyatza vehizzika patur. veim enah yechola laamod beruach metzuya o shehayu katle haddir reuin hare lo naal bifnehen karauy veim yatzat vehizzika chayyav. vaafillu chatra veyatzat vaafillu nifretza mechitztza ballayla o peratzuha listim baal hatztzon chayyav. hayta mechitztza beria venifretza ballayla o shepperatzuha listim veyatzat vehizzika patur. hotziuha listim vehizzika listim chayyavim: 
Happoretz gader lifne behemat chavero veyatzat vehizzika. im haya gader chazak uvari chayyav. veim haya kotel raua patur bedine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. vechen hannoten sam hammavet lifne behemat chavero patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim: 
Hammaamid behemat chavero al gabbe kamat chavero hammaamid chayyav leshallem ma shehizzik. vechen im hikkishah ad shehalcha lekamat chavero vehizzika ze shehikkishah chayyav: 
Hammoser behemto leshomer chinnam o lenose sachar o lesocher o leshoel nichnesu tachat habbealim veim hizzika chayyav hashshomer. bamme devarim amurim bizman shello shemaruha kelal. aval im shemaruha shemira meulla karauy veyatzat vehizzika hashshomrim peturin vehabbealim chayyavim afillu hemita et haadam. shemaruha shemira pechuta im shomer chinnam hu patur veim shomer sachar o socher o shoel hu chayyavin: 
Hinnichah bachamma afillu chatra veyatzat vehizzika chayyav ze shehinnichah sham. shekkevan shehinnichah bachamma hare hi mitztaeret uvorachat veosa kol sheefshar lah laasot: 
Masar behemto lecheresh shote vekatan af al pi shehaya hashshor kashur habbealim chayyavin. shedderech hashshor vechayyotze bo lehattir hakkesher velatzet ulehazzik. afillu shemaruha shemira meulla vechatra veyatza vehizzika habbealim chayyavim: 
Masar shoro lachamishsha ufasha bo echad mehen veyatza vehizzik im eno mishtammer ella bachamishshetan ze sheppasha bishmirato chayyav. veim mishtammer bisheran af ellu hannisharin chayyavin: 
Shealo bechezkat tam venimtza muad. im yada hashshoel shehu nagchan habbealim meshallemim chatzi nezek shekkol makom shehu holech hare shem bealav alav. vehashshoel meshallem chatzi nezek. sheafillu haya tam (kesheala bedato) chatzi nezek haya meshallem shehare yada shehu nagchan. veim lo yada shehu nagchan en hashshoel chayyav kelum vehabbealim meshallemin nezek shalem: 
Shealo keshehu tam vehuad bevet hashshoel vehecheziro livalav chazar letammuto. hoil venishtannet reshuto batla hahaada vehabbealim meshallemin chatzi nezek vehashshoel patur shehare hecheziro: 
Shomer shekkibbel alav shemirat guf habbehema bilvad aval lo shemirat nezakeha vehizzika patur milleshallem vehabbealim chayyavim. kibbel shemirat nezakeha vehizzika chayyav hashshomer. veim huzzeka patur vehabbealim osim din im hammazzik: 
Masar hashshomer leshomer acher hashshomer harishon chayyav leshallem lannizzak shehashshomer shemmasar leshomer chayyav. vahare hannizzak omer lo lamma lo shamarta atta beatzmecha umasarta leacher shalem li atta velech vaase din im hashshomer shemmasarta lo atta. mesarah hashshomer livno o leven beto o limsaado nichnesu tachat hashshomer vechayyavim: 
Kol shomer shennitchayyev leshallem veen lo vehaya hammazzik tam shehu meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo hare hannizzak mishtallem min habbehema shehizzika veyishshaer deme ma sheggava hannizzak chov al hashshomer levaal habbehema: 
Kol behema shehizzika perot mechubbarin meshaarin ma shehizzika beshishshim umeshallem ze shennitchayyev leshallem ben habbealim ben hashshomrim. ketzad. hare sheachla bet sea shamin shishshim bet sea beotah hassade kamma haya shave vechamma hu shave atta achar shennifsad bo habbet sea umeshallem hashshear. vechen im achla kav o rova afillu kelach echad shamin oto beshishshim: 
Achla perot gemurin sheen tzerichim lakkarka meshallem deme perot gemurin bishvehen im sea deme sea veim satayim deme satayim. hare sheachla perot dekel echad vechen halloket perot dekel chavero veachal im haya dekel romi vechayyotze bo sheen hattemarim shello yafot meshaarin oto beshishshim al gav hakkarka. veim dekel parsi vechayyotze bo hu shehattemarim shello yafot beyoter meshaarin haddekel bifne atzmo kamma haya shave vechamma hu shave atta:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 5:
Behema shehayta roa ufarsha venichnesa bassadot uvakkeramim af al pi sheadayin lo hizzika matrin bivaleha shalosh peamim. im lo shamar behemto velo menaah millirot yesh reshut levaal hassade leshochotah shechita keshera veomer livaleha bou umichru basar shellachem. mippene sheasur laadam lehazzik uleshallem ma shehizzik afillu ligrom hannezek asur: 
Lefichach asru chachamim legaddel behema dakka vechayya dakka beeretz yisrael bimkom hassadot vehakkeramim ella bayarim uvammidbarot shebbeeretz yisrael. umegaddelin besureya bechol makom: 
Asara tenaim hitna yehoshua uvet dino beshaa shechillek et haaretz veellu hen. 1) hitna shemmarin behema dakka biarim sheilanehen gassin. aval en marin sham behema gassa. uveyaar sheilanav dakkim en marin bo lo gassa velo dakka ella middaat bealav. 2) vechen hitna sheyyihye kol adam muttar lelakket etzim missede chavero. vehu sheyyihyu etzim pechutim ukerovim lihyot kotzim kegon hizme vehige. vehu sheyyihyu lachim umechubbarin uvilvad shello yesharesh. aval shear etzim asur. 3) vechen hitna sheyyihye kol adam muttar lelakket asavim haolin mealehen bechol makom chutz missede tiltan shezzeraah livhema. 4) vechen hitna sheyyihye adam kotem netia bechol makom chutz miggerofiyyot shel zayit veeno kotem min hailanot ella bezayit kevetza uvekanim uvigfanim min happekak ulemala uvishar hailan mittocho shel ilan lo mechuddo. ucheshehittir liktom lo hittir ella mechadash sheeno ose perot aval lo miyyashan sheose perot. veeno kotem ella mimmakom sheeno roe pene chamma. 5) vechen hitna shehammayan hayyotze battechilla bene otah hair sheyyatza bigvulam mistappekin mimmennu af al pi sheen ikkaro bechelkam. veen laacherim lehistappek immahem mimmennu. 6) vechen hitna sheyyihye kol adam muttar latzud dagim miyyam teverya vehu sheyyatzud bechakka bilvad. aval lo yifrosho kela veyaamid sefina sham ella bene hashshevet shehiggia oto hayyam bechelkam. 7) vechen hitna shekkol adam shetztzarich linkavav mistallek min hadderech venichnas achore haggader sheppaga bo venifne sham vaafillu besade melea karkom venotel mishsham tzeror umekanneach. 8) vechen hitna shekkol hattoe ben hakkeramim vechayyotze bahen mefasseg veole mefasseg veyored ad sheyyetze ledarko. 9) vechen hitna shebbizman sheyyirbe hattit bedarche harabbim o nekie mayim yesh leovre derachim lehistallek letzidde hadderachim umehallechin sham af al pi shehen mehallechin bederech sheyyesh lah bealim. 10) vechen hitna shemmet mitzva kone mekomo venikbar bammakom sheyyimmatze bo. shello yihye muttal al hammetzar velo betoch techum hammedina. aval im nimtza al hammetzar o shehaya betoch hattechum mevio levet hakkevarot: 
Shelomo tikken sheyyihyu ovre derachim muttarin bimot hachamma lehallech bashshevilin shebbassadot sheyyesh lahen bealim ad shettered revia sheniyya: 
Vetakkanot ellu kullan nohagot bechol makom afillu bechutza laaretz: 
Umishsheyyarad hattal bevavel asur lehallech bishvilin sheyyesh lahen bealim: 
Af al pi sheen megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael muttar lashhotah kodem laregel sheloshim yom vekodem lemishte beno sheloshim yom. vehattabbach lokeach veshochet lokeach umashhe ad sheyyishchot meat meat. uvilvad shello tetze vetire baeder. ella kol hammashhe mashhe betoch beto kede shello tazzik: 
Uchevar asu bavel keeretz yisrael leesor bah giddul behema dakka vechayya dakka mippene shehayu rov hassadot vehakkeramim sham beotan hayyamim shel yisrael: 
Vechen asru chachamim legaddel chazirim bechol makom. velo et hakkelev ella im ken haya kashur beshalshelet. aval megaddel hu kelavim bair hassemucha lassefar. bayyom koshro uvallayla mattiro. veamru chachamim arur megaddel kelavim vachazirim mippene shehezzekan merubbe umatzuy: 
Roe sheasa teshuva en mechayyevin oto limkor miyyad ella mocher al yad al yad. vechen mi shennaflu lo kelavim vachazirim birushsha en mechayyevin oto limkor miyyad ella mocher meat meat:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 6:
Ezehu muad kol sheheidu bo shelosha yamim. aval im nagach beyom echad o nashach o ravatz o baat o nagaf afillu mea peamim en ze muad. heidu bo shelosha kitte edim beyom echad hare ze safek im huad o lo huad: 
En heada ella bifne habbealim uvifne bet din shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 29)</small> "vehuad bivalav". veen heada ella bevet din: 
Shor shel cheresh shote vekatan umi shehu bimdinat hayyam shennagchu peturin. aval bet din maamidin lahem appotroppesin umeidin bahen bifne haappotroppesin: 
Hizziku achar shehuadu bifne appotroppesin im adayin hu tam meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo veim huad bo shelosha yamim veachar kach hizzik meshallem nezek shalem min hayyafe shebbenichse appotroppesin. velichsheyyigdelu hayetomim yaasu din im haappotroppesin vishallemu lahen: 
Shevarim shemmesachakin bahen umelammedin otan liggach ze et ze enam muadim ze laze. vaafillu hemitu et haadam enan chayyavin mita shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 28)</small> "chi yiggach" lo sheyyaggichuhu: 
Shor shehuad venimkar o nittan bemattana chazar letammuto sheharshut shennishtannet meshanna dino. aval im hishilo o mesaro leshomer hare hu bechezkato. vechen shor shehuad bifne appotroppesin venitpakkeach hacheresh venishtappa hashshota vehigdil hakkatan af al pi shebbatlu haappotroppesin hare hen muadin bechezkatan shehare birshut bealim hen: 
Behema shehuada vechazra bah middavar shehuada lo chazra letammutah. ketzad. shor shehuad liggach vechazar shello liggach af al pi shehu nogef hare ze tam lingicha. umeematay hu chazarato ad sheyyihyu hattinokot memashmeshin bo veeno nogeach. vechen bishar haddevarim shehuad lahen ad sheyyemashmeshu bo velo yihye ose otan: 
Shor shehu muad lemino hare ze eno muad lesheeno mino. huad leadam eno moed livhema. huad liktannim eno muad ligdolim. lefichach im hizzik et min shehu muad lo meshallem nezek shalem veim hizzik lishar hamminin meshallem chatzi nezek. haya muad leshabbatot eno muad limot hachol veim hizzik beshabbatot meshallem nezek shalem uvimot hachol meshallem chatzi nezek. umeematay hi chazarato mishsheyyemashmeshu hattinokot bo bayyom shehu muad lo velo yihye mazzik nezek shehuad lo: 
Nagach shor hayyom vachamor lemachar vegamal beyom shelishi naasa muad lakkol. raa shor hayyom unegacho. ulemachar raa shor velo negacho. uvayyom hashshelishi raa shor unegacho. uvarvii raa shor velo negacho. uvachamishi raa shor unegacho. uvashshishshi raa shor velo negacho. naasa muad leserugin lishvarim. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Raa shor hayyom unegacho. ulemachar raa chamor velo negacho. uvashshelishi raa sus unegacho. uvarvii raa gamal velo negacho. uvachamishi raa pered unegacho. uvashshishshi raa arod velo negacho. naasa muad leserugin lakkol veim nagach bayyom shehu muad lo echad mishsheloshet hamminin shennagach beserugin hare ze muad: 
Nagach bachamishsha asar lechodesh ze. uveshishsha asar lechodesh sheni. uveshiva asar lechodesh shelishi. eno muad ad sheyyeshallesh baddillug. shama kol shofar venagach kol shofar venagach kol shofar venagach naasa muad leshofarot. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Nagach shelosha shevarim bishlosha yamim ze achar ze uvarvii nagach chamor uvachamishi nagach gamal o shennagach chamor vegamal battechilla bishne yamim ze achar ze veachar kach nagach shelosha shevarim ze achar ze hare ze safek im hu muad lishvarim bilvad o lishloshet hamminin hu muad. vechen im nagach beshalosh shabbatot zo achar zo uveechad beshabbat uvesheni beshabbat o shennagach bachamishi beshabbat uveerev shabbat uveyom hashshabbat uvishte shabbatot habbaot achareha hare ze safek im hu muad leshabbatot bilvad o lishloshet hayyamim sheshshenayim mehen chal: 
Vechol ellu hassefekot vechayyotze bahen en mechayyevin bahen et hammazzik ella chatzi nezek. veim tafas hannizzak nezek shalem en motziin miyyado:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 7:
Shor shekkesharo bealav bemosera venaal befanav karauy veyatza vehizzik. im tam hu meshallem chatzi nezek. veim haya muad patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 36)</small> "velo yishmerennu" ha im shemaro patur veshamur hu ze. vechen im hizzik bedavar shehu muad lo mittechillato kegon sheachal devarim haruyim lo o shavar beraglav bederech hillucho patur milleshallem: 
Haya muad lekeren yamin veeno muad lekeren semol veyatza achar sheshshemaro karauy venagach ben bekeren yamin ben bismol meshallem chatzi nezek: 
Behema shechavla beadam ben bechavvana ben shello bechavvana. im tamma hi meshallem chatzi nezek miggufah veim muedet hi meshallem nezek shalem. ufatur min hashshevet umin habboshet umin hatztzaar umin harippuy. shearbaa devarim ellu lo chiyyeva bahen tora ella beadam shechaval bachavero aval behema shechavla baadam hare ze kemi shehizzika mamono sheeno chayyav ella chatzi nezek bilvad. lefichach shoro shebbiyyesh patur veim biyyesh hu beatzmo chayyav kemo sheyyitbaer. veshoro shechaval beaviv o beimmo o shehidlik gedish chavero beshabbat chayyav binzakin veillu haya hu beatzmo haose ze patur milleshallem kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Hammachnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut unegacho shoro shel baal habbayit o neshacho kalbo patur. veim nagach hu shor shel baal habbayit. im haya tam meshallem chatzi nezek veim haya muad meshallem nezek shalem kedin hannogeach birshut harabbim: 
Nafal levor shebbechatzer zo vehivish et memav. im hivish et memav miyyad bishat nefila chayyav benizke hammayim. veim achar zeman patur. shehare naasa hashshor takkala kevor vehammayim hare hen kechelim velo matzinu bor shechiyyev bo et hakkelim. veim hichnis birshut baal hashshor patur. veim kibbel alav baal habbayit lishmor hare hu chayyav benezek hashshor shennafal labbor: 
Hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut vehizzik et baal habbayit. o shehuzzak bo baal habbayit. o shechafar bechatzer borot shichin umearot. baal hashshor chayyav benizke chatzer uvaal chatzer chayyav benizke habbor shehare alav lesatmo: 
Hizzik baal habbayit et hashshor. im hizziko shello ledaat patur. shehare omrin lo lamma nichnasta shello birshut. shello yadati ad sheshshagagti becha. veim hizziko ledaat chayyav nezek shalem. mippene sheyyesh lo reshut lehotzio mershuto aval lehazziko en lo reshut: 
Shamin linzakin. ketzad. hare sheshshavar keli shel chavero ben hu ben behemto en omrin lammazzik kach atta hakkeli hashshavur veshallem laze deme hakkeli ella omdin kamma pachat hakkeli middamav venoten lo kol happechat im hammazzik muad o chatzi happechat im haya tam shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 34)</small> "vehammet yihye lo" lannizzak. pechat hannevela al hannizzak. veshevach hannevela cholkin oto hannizzak vehammazzik: 
Ketzad. shor shave matayim shennegachuhu umet vahare hannevela shava bishat mita mea uvishat haamada baddin pachata vahare shava shemonim. en hammazzik meshallem ella mea im haya muad. veim haya tam meshallem lo chamishshim miggufo: 
Hishbicha hannevela vahare hi shava bishat haamada baddin mea veesrim. hare hammazzik meshallem lo tishim im haya muad. veim haya tam meshallem arbaim vachamishsha miggufo vezehu shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 la)</small> "vegam et hammet yechetzun" [shevach hammet yechetzun]: 
Shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim vehifchito chamishshim uvishat haamada baddin hishbiach hannizzak vahare hu shave arba meot zuz veillule hannegicha shehifchito haya shave shemone meot. ben sheppittemo ben sheshshibbeach meelav en noten ella kishat hannezek. kichesh mechamat hammakka bishat haamada baddin vahare happechat shave mea noten lo kishat haamada baddin: 
Hishbiach hammazzik bishat haamada baddin. im mechamat sheppittemo shibbeach eno mishtallem mimmennu ella ma shehaya shave beshaa shehizzik. veim mechamat atzmo hishbiach mishtallem chatzi nezek mimmennu kullo kishat haamada baddin: 
Al hammazzik litroach bannevela ad shemmamtzi otah lannizzak. ketzad. kegon shennafal hashshor labbor umet maale hannevela min habbor venotnah lannizzak veachar kach shamin lo pechat nevela shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 34)</small> "kesef yashiv livalav vehammet yihye lo". melammed shehu chayyav lehashiv et hannevela veet happechat sheppachata min hachay lannizzak. veim haya tam chatzi happechat. kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 8: Shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel hekdesh o shor shel hekdesh shennagach shor shel yisrael patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 la)</small> "shor reehu". vechol hakkadashim shechayyavin bahen meila en bahen din nezakin. ufesule hammukdashin yesh bahen din nezakin ben shehizziku ben shehuzzeku shehare yatzu lappidyon velihyotam chullin:

Shelamim shehizziku gove mibbesaram veeno gove min habbasar keneged emurehen. shehaemurim shel kadashim kallim moalin bahen kemo shebbearnu behilchot meila. vechen toda shehizzika gove mibbesarah veeno gove min hallechem habba immah sheen hallechem mikkelal basar:

Vechetzad gove. sheyyochal hannizzak vachavurato min habbasar bikdushsha keneged chatzi nezek shello. vechetzad eno gove keneged haemurin. sheim haya lo ligbot bachatzi nizko sheve dinar vehaya kol habbasar im haemurin shave shene dinarim vehabbasar belo emurin shave dinar vachetzi eno gove shene shelishi habbasar ella chatzi habbasar bilvad:

Vechen shor hefker shehizzik patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 la)</small> "shor reehu" ad sheyyihyu hannechasim meyuchadim labbealim. ketzad. shor hahefker shennagach vekodem sheyyitposho oto hannizzak ba acher vezacha bo hare ze patur. velo od ella shor hameyuchad labbealim shehizzik veachar shehizzik hakedisho o hifkiro hare ze patur ad sheyyihyu lo bealim bishat hezzeko uvishat haamada baddin:

Shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel akkum ben tam ben muad patur. lefi sheen haakkum mechayyevin et haadam al behemto shehizzika vahare anu danin lahem kedinehem. veshor shel akkum shennagach shel yisrael ben tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem. kenas hu ze leakkum lefi sheenan zehirin bemitzvot veenan mesallekin hannezek veim lo techayyev otan al nizke behemtan en meshammerin otah umafsidin mamon habberiyyot:

Shor tam shehizzik im mecharo hammazzik ad shello amad baddin af al pi shehu machur hare hannizzak gove hemennu vechozer hallokeach vegove min hammazzik shemmachar lo. shekkevan shennagach kol yesh lo velo haya lo lallokeach likkach ad sheyyigbe hannizzak:
Hikdisho hammazzik hare ze mukdash kede shello yomru hekdesh yotze belo pidyon. shechato gove mibbesaro. netano bemattana ma sheasa asuy veyigbe hannizzak mimmennu:

Hizzik veamad baddin veachar kach mecharo eno machur. hikdisho eno mukdash. netano bemattana lo asa velo kelum. kadmu baale chovot shel mazzik utefasuhu ben shechav ad shello hizzik ben hizzik ad shello chav lo zachu ella hannizzak gove mimmennu sheafillu haya shel baale chovot mittechilla vehizzik hare ze gove miggufo:

Muad shehizzik ben amad baddin ben shello amad baddin vehikdisho o mecharo o netano bemattana o shechato. ma sheasa asuy. kadmu baale chovot vehinhiguhu ben chav ad shello hizzik ben hizzik ad shello chav zachu bo. lefi sheen mishtallem hannizzak ella min hameulle shebbenichse hammazzik vahare kol nechasav meshubadin lenezek ze:

Keshebbet din nizkakin ligbot lannizzak minnichse hammazzik govin min hammittaltelin techilla veim lo hayu lo mittaltelin kelal o shello hayu lo mittaltelin keneged kol hannezek govin hashshear min hakkarka hameulla shebbenichse hammazzik. vechol zeman sheyyimtzeu mittaltelin vaafillu subbin en nizkakin lakkarka:

Met hammazzik kodem sheyyeshallem en bet din nizkakin lammittaltelin shel yetomim ella lakkarka. vegovin lannizzak min hazzibburit. mippene shehannizak naasa kevaal chov vehammittaltelin enan meshubadin levaal chov. veim tafas hannizzak hammittaltelin bechayye hammazzik govin lo mehem leachar moto:

Kevar tikkenu haggeonim ligbot baal chov min hammittaltelin. ufashta takkana zo bechol batte dinin. lefichach megabbin hannezakin min hammittaltelin shel yetomim. veim lo hinniach mittaltelin govin lo min hazzibburit shekkol habba lippara minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella min hazzibburit kemo shebbearnu:

En hannezakin mishtallemin veen chayyavin bechofer veen habbehema nehereget ella biraya berura uveedim hakkesherim lehaid. shello tomar hoil veen metzuyin beurvot hassusim uverefet habbakar vegidrot tzon ella haavadim veharoim vechayyotze bahen im heidu shebbehema zo hizzika et zo shomin lahem veim heidu ketannim o nashim sheadam ze chaval et ze o heidu bishar nezakin somchin alehen. en haddavar ken. ella en mechayyevin leolam mamon al pi edim ad sheyyihyu edim hakkesherim lehaid shear eduyyot veyaidu vichayyevu bet din hammazzik leshallem:

Shor shehaya roe al gabbe hannahar venimtza shor harug betziddo. af al pi shezze menuggach veze muad liggach ze menushshach veze muad lishshach. en omrim beyadua shezze neshacho veze negacho. vaafillu gamal haocher ben haggemallim venimtza [gamal] harug betziddo en omrim beyadua shezze harago ad sherauhu edim kesherim:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 9:
Behema meubberet shehizzika gove chatzi nezek mimmenna umivveladah mippene shehu miggufah. aval tarnegolet shehizzika eno gove mibbetzatah mippene shehabbetza enah miggufah aval muvdelet umufreshet mimmenna: 
Meubberet shennagcha venimtza veladah betziddah veen yadua im ad shello nagcha yalda o achar shennagcha yalda. meshallem chatzi nezek min happara veeno gove min havvalad kelum ad sheyyavi reaya shebbeshaa shennagcha hayta meubberet. shehammotzi mechavero alav lehavi haraya: 
Shor shennagach para meubberet venimtza ubbarah nofel betziddah veen yadua im ad shello negachah hippila o mechamat negicha hippila. meshallem nezek happara veeno meshallem nezek havvalad. shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Nagach para meubberet vehippila. en shamin pechat para bifne atzmah ufechat havvalad bifne atzmo. ella shamin kamma hayta happara shava keshehayta meubberet uveria vechamma hi shava achshav hi vehannefel shellah umeshallem happechat o chetzyo im haya tam: 
Hayta happara leechad vehavvalad leechad hare pechat hashshumman sheppachat guf happara levaal happara. ufechat hannefach cholkin oto baal happara im baal havvalad. vehannefel shel baal havvalad: 
Shor shehaya rodef achar shor acher vehuzzak. hannizzak omer shorcha hizzik veze omer eni yodea shemma besela laka. hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. veaf al pi shehannizak omer eni yodea bevadday veze omer eni yodea. taan hannizzak veamar vadday atta yodea sheshshorcha hizzik hare ze nishba shevuat hesset sheeno yodea im haya muad. aval im haya tam patur af mishshevuat hesset sheafillu hoda meatzmo patur shechatzi nezek kenas hu umode biknas patur hu: 
Hayu shenayim rodfin achar echad vahare edim sheechad mehen hizzik veen haedim yodim ezehu mishshenehem. ze omer shorcha hizzik veze omer shorcha hizzik shenehem peturin. veim hayu shenehem shel ish echad chayyav leshallem migguf happachut shebbishnehem. veim hayu muadin meshallem nezek shalem minnechasav: 
Bamme devarim amurim besheshshene hashshevarim omdin. aval im met echad mehen o avad vehaya echad mehen tam af al pi shehen shel ish echad patur. shehare omer lo have reaya shezze haomed hu shehizzik vaashallem lecha: 
Hayu shene hashshevarim harodfin echad gadol veechad katan. hannizzak omer gadol hizzik vehammazzik omer katan hizzik. haya echad tam veechad muad hannizzak omer muad hizzik vehammazzik omer tam hizzik. hammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Lo hayta sham reaya berura shezze hizzik ella edim meidim sheechad mishshene ellu hizzik meshallem hammazzik kemo sheomer. veim taan hannizzak sheatta yodea vadday shezze hizzik befanecha hare hammazzik nishba shevuat hattora umeshallem kemo shehoda shehare hoda bemiktzat: 
Hayu hannizzakin shenayim echad gadol veechad katan vehammazzikin echad gadol veechad katan. hannizzak omer gadol hizzik et haggadol vehakkatan et hakkatan vehammazzik omer lo ki ella katan hizzik et haggadol vegadol et hakkatan. o shehaya echad tam veechad muad hannizzak omer hammuad hizzik et haggadol vetam hizzik et hakkatan vehammazzik omer tam hizzik et haggadol vehammuad hizzik et hakkatan. hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. lo hayta sham reaya berura hammazzik patur. lema ze dome leze toen et chavero chittim vehoda lo bisorim shehu nishba shevuat hesset ufatur af middeme seorim kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot toen. veim tafas hannizzak hare ze meshallem lakkatan min haggadol velaggadol min hakkatan kemo shehoda hammazzik. aval im lo tafas en motziin min hammazzik kelum: 
Shor shennagach vechazar venagach shor acher hare hannizzak harishon vehabbealim shuttafin bo. ketzad. shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim veen hannevela yafa kelum hannizzak notel mea uvaal hashshor mea. chazar venagach shor acher shave matayim veen hannevela yafa kelum haacharon notel mea vehannizzak shellefanav im habbealim notlin chamishshim chamishshim zuz. chazar venagach shor acher shave matayim veen hannevela yafa kelum haacharon notel mea venizzak shellefanav chamishshim vehannizzak harishon im habbealim esrim vachamishsha esrim vachamishsha. vechen al derech zo cholkin veholchim: 
Nizzak shettafas behema shehizzika ligbot chatzi nizko miggufah naasa aleha shomer sachar linzakin veim yatzta vehizzika hannizzak harishon chayyav binzakeha vehabbealim peturin. ketzad. shor shave matayim shennagach vehifsid matayim utefaso hannizzak ligbot mimmennu mea vechazar venagach vehifsid bemea vearbaim hare hannizzak haacharon mishtallem shivim vehannizzak harishon shettefaso mishtallem motar nizko vehu sheloshim vehabbealim mea. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shene shevarim tammim shechavlu ze baze meshallemin bammotar chatzi nezek. shenehem muadin (o muad veadam) shechavlu ze baze meshallemin bammotar nezek shalem. echad tam veechad muad. muad betam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem tam bemuad meshallem bammotar chatzi nezek. ketzad. shor tam shehifsid beshor tam acher sheve mane vechazar ze haacharon vehifsid barishon sheve arbaim hare baal harishon meshallem labbaal haacharon sheloshim. hayu shenehem muadin baal harishon meshallem shishshim. harishon muad veacharon tam baal harishon meshallem shemonim. harishon tam vehaacharon muad baal harishon meshallem asara:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 10:
Shor shehemit et haadam bechol makom ben gadol ben katan ben eved ben ben chorin echad tam veechad muad hare ze niskal. veim hemit et haakkum patur kedinehem: 
Echad shor veechad shear behema chayya veof shehemitu hare ellu niskalin. ma ben tam sheharag et haadam lemuad sheharag et haadam. shehattam patur min hakkofer vehammuad chayyav bechofer uvilvad sheyyihye muad laharog: 
Vehoil vechol behema chayya veof shehargu et haadam niskalin heach yimmatze muad laharog ad sheyyeshallemu bealav et hakkofer. kegon sheharag shelosha ovde kochavim veachar kach harag yisrael shehammuad leakkum hare ze muad leyisrael. o sheharag shelosha yisrael terefa veachar kach harag shalem. o sheharag uvarach uvarvii nitpas. sheen habbealim chayyavin bechofer ad sheyyissakel hashshor. vechen im sikken shelosha bene adam keechad o sheharag shalosh behemot hare ze muad lahariga uvealim meshallemin et hakkofer. vechen im hikkiru edim et baal hashshor velo hikkiru et hashshor befaam rishona usheniyya ushelishit uvarviit rau shoro sheharag velo hayu yodin im ze hu hashshor sheharag beshalosh peamim harishonot o acher haya. hoil vehuadu habbealim sheyyesh lahem bivkaram shor sheharag shalosh peamim haya lahem lishmor kol behemtam umeachar shello shamru meshallemin et hakkofer: 
Ze shekkatuv battora <small>(Shemot 21 29)</small> "vegam bealav yumat" mippi hashshemua lamdu shechiyyuv mita zo bide shamayim veim natan kofer hanneherag mitkapper lo. veaf al pi shehakkofer kappara memashkenin mi shennitchayyev bechofer beal karcho: 
Shor shel shene shuttafin sheharag. kol echad mehem meshallem kofer shalem shehare kol echad mehen tzarich kappara gemura: 
En gomrin dino shel shor ella bifne bealav im hayu lo bealim. aval im lo hayu lo bealim kegon shor hammidbar veshor shel hekdesh veshor shel ger shemmet veen lo yorshin im hemit hare ze niskal vegomrin dino af al pi sheen lo bealim. vechen shor haishsha veshor hayetomim veshor haappotroppesim shehemitu niskalin. veen haappotroppesim meshallemin et hakkofer shehakkofer kappara hu veen hakketannim vehachershim vehashshotim bene chiyyuv kede sheyyihyu tzerichin kappara: 
Shor shehu terefa sheharag et hannefesh o shehaya hashshor shel adam terefa eno niskal shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 29)</small> "vegam bealav yumat" kemitat habbealim kach mitat hashshor. vechevan shebbealav kemet hem chashuvim veenan tzerichin mita hare ze patur: 
Hameshasse kelev bachavero vaharago en hakkelev niskal. vechen im gera bo behema o chayya vaharaguhu. aval im shissa bo nachash vaafillu hishshicho bo vaharago hannachash niskal. sheeres hannachash shemmemit meatzmo mekio lefichach ze haadam shehishshich bo nachash patur mimmitat bet din: 
En habbehema niskelet im hemita ad shennitkavvena lehazzik lemi shehi chayyevet alav sekila. aval shor shehaya mitkavven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam. nitkavvin leakkum veharag leyisrael. nitkavven linfalim veharag ben kayyama. patur min hammita. veim haya muad habbealim chayyavin bechofer. o biknas im hemit eved. veaf al pi sheharag belo kavvana hoil vehu muad laze: 
Haya muad lippol al bene haadam bevorot veraa yarak babbor venafal labbor bishvil hayyarak vehaya sham adam umet. o shehaya muad lehitchakkech bakketalim ulehappil al bene adam venitchakkech bakkotel lahanaato venafal al adam umet mechamat chikkucho. hashshor patur mimmita lefi shello nitkavven lehamit vehabbealim chayyavin bechofer shehare ze muad lippol bevorot al bene adam o lehappil alehem hakketalim. veheach yodea shennitchakkech lahanaato. keshennitchakkech leachar shehippil vehemit: 
En habbealim meshallemin et hakkofer ad shettamit behemtan chutz mershutan. aval im hemit birshut hammazzik af al pi shehu biskila habbealim peturin min hakkofer. ketzad. hannichnas lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshuto vaafillu nichnas litboa secharo o chovo mimmennu unegacho shoro shel baal habbayit umet. hashshor biskila vehabbealim peturin min hakkofer. shehare en lo reshut likkanes lirshuto shel ze shello middato:
