Amad bappetach vekara levaal habbayit veamar lo hen. venichnas unegacho shoro shel baal habbayit hare habbealim peturin. sheen mashma hen ella amod bimkomcha ad sheadabber immecha: 
Behema shennichnesa lachatzar hannizzak vedarsa al gabbe tinok derech hilluchah vaharagathu habbealim meshallemin et hakkofer sheharegel muedet lehazzik bederech hilluchah uvirshut hannizzak chayyav af al hashshen veal haregel kemo shebbearnu. nimtzeta lamed shehammuad shehemit bechavvana niskal vehabbealim chayyavin bechofer veim hemit shello bechavvana patur min hammita vehabbealim chayyavin bechofer. vetam shehemit shello bechavvana patur min hammita umin hakkofer. veim nitkavven lehamit niskal vehabbealim peturin min hakkofer vechen mikkenas shel eved: 
Nire li sheaf al pi shehattam shehemit bechavvana eved o shifcha patur min hakkenas shehu sheloshim sela hakkatuv battora. im hemit shello bechavvana meshallem chatzi deme haeved o chatzi deme hashshifcha miggufo keillu hemit shor chavero o chamoro:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 11:
Kamma hu hakkofer. kemo sherau haddayyanin shehu deme hanneherag hakkol lefi shavyo shel neherag shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 30)</small> "venatan pidyon nafsho kechol asher yushat alav". vechofer haavadim ben gedolim ben ketannim ben zecharim ben nekevot hu hakkenas hakkatzuv battora sheloshim sela kesef yafe ben shehaya haeved shave mea mane ben sheeno shave ella dinar. vechol hameukkav get shichrur en lo kenas hoil veen lo adon shehare yatza lecherut: 
Lemi notnin hakkofer. leyorshe hanneherag. veim hemit ishsha hakkofer leyorsheha meaviha veeno labbaal. hemit mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin noten chatzi kenas lerabbo vehachetzi haacher rauy litten veen mi yikkachennu: 
Shor shennagach ishsha veyatzu yeladeha af al pi shehu muad liggach habbealim peturin middeme veladot. shello chiyyeva tora bidme veladot ella laadam: 
Nagach shifcha veyatzu yeladeha meshallem deme veladot. shezze kemi shennagach chamor meubberet. veim haya tam meshallem chatzi deme veladot miggufo: 
Ketzad shamin otah. omdin kamma hayta shifcha zo shava keshehayta meebberet vechamma hi shava atta venoten livaleha happechat o chetzyo. veim hemit hashshifcha meshallem hakkofer hakkatzuv battora bilvad kemo shebbearnu: 
Shor shennitkavven livhema venagach et haadam af al pi sheim hemito patur kemo shebbearnu im chaval bo chayyav benezek. veim tam hu meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo. veim muad nezek shalem: 
Shor tam shehemit vehizzik danin oto dine nefashot veen danin oto dine mamonot. umuad shehemit vehizzik danin oto dine mamonot vechozrin vedanin oto dine nefashot. kadmu vedanuhu dine nefashot techilla chozrin vedanin oto dine mamonot: 
Umehechan mishtallem min hashshevach shehishbiach birdiyyato achar shennigmar dino. shekkevan shennigmar dino liskila en lo bealim sheyyitchayyevu binzakav. danuhu dine nefashot uvarach en danin oto dine mamonot: 
Shor shehemit et haadam vehikdisho bealav eno kadosh. vechen im hifkiro eno mufkar. mecharo eno machur. hecheziro shomer livalav enah chazara. shechato besaro asur bahanaa. bamme devarim amurim achar shennigmar dino liskila. aval ad shello nigmar dino liskila im hikdisho mukdash veim hifkiro hare hu mufkar. mecharo hare ze machur. hecheziro shomer livalav hare ze muchzar. veim kadam ushechato hare ze muttar baachila: 
Shor shello nigmar dino shennitarev bishvarim acherim kullan peturin lefi sheen gomrin dino shel shor ella bifne hashshor kedin haadam. nigmar dino veachar kach nitarev baacherim afillu beelef kullan niskalim venikbarin vaasurin bahanaa kedin behema niskelet: 
Para meubberet shehemita et haadam vechen kol behema shenneevda bah avera hare ebbarah kamoha. hi veebbarah nagcha hi veubbarah nirbea: 
Nagcha vehemita veachar kach nitabbera. im ad shello nigmar dinah nitabbera veyalda kodem gemar din veladah muttar veim yalda achar gemar din veladah asur shehaubbar yerech immo hu. veim nitarev valad ze baacherim konsin et kullam bechippa ad sheyyamutu sham: 
Shor hanniskal shehuzammu edav kol hakkodem bo zacha shehare mishshennigmar dino hifkiruhu bealav. veim heidu shebbealav ribbeahu vehezim et haedim hare hashshor livalav vehakkodem umeshacho lo zacha bo shekkevan shehabbaal yodea beatzmo shello chata vesheellu ede sheker hem vahare hu meyachel lahazimam lo hifkir:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 12:
Hachofer bor birshut harabbim venafal letocho shor o chamor umet afillu haya habbor male gizzot shel tzemer vechayyotze bahen hare baal habbor chayyav leshallem nezek shalem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 34)</small> "baal habbor yeshallem". veechad shor vachamor o shear mine behema chayya veof lo neemar <small>(Shemot 21 33)</small> "shor vachamor" ella bahove: 
Echad hachofer bor birshut harabbim o hachofer bor birshuto ufitcho lirshut harabbim o patach lirshut chavero o shechafar ufatach lirshuto vehifkir reshuto velo hifkir boro hare ze chayyav binzakav. aval im hifkir reshuto uvoro o shehifkir boro shebbirshuto o hikdisho hare ze patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 34)</small> "baal habbor yeshallem" mi sheyyesh lo bealim veze hefker uvattechilla birshut chafar mippene shechafar birshuto: 
Echad hachofer bor o shennechpar meelav o shechafarattu behema o chayya hoil vehu chayyav lemalleoto o lechassoto velo asa hare ze chayyav binzakav. vechad hachofer o hallokeach o shennittan lo bemattana shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 34)</small> "baal habbor yeshallem" mi sheyyesh lo bealim mikkol makom: 
Echad hachofer o hamegalle makom shehaya mechusse shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 33)</small> "chi yiftach ish bor o ki yichre". veim chissahu karauy af al pi shehitlia mittocho venafal letocho shor umet patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 33)</small> "velo yechassennu" ha im kissahu patur. kissahu bedavar sheyyachol laamod bifne shevarim veeno yachol laamod bifne gemallim vehalchu alav gemallim venitroea vehalchu alav shevarim venaflu bo. im en haggemallim metzuyin beoto makom hare ze patur mippene shezze ones. veim yavou sham gemallim afillu lifrakim hare ze chayyav: 
Hitlia mittocho venaflu bo shevarim af al pi shehaggemallim metzuyin sham tamid vahare hu poshea laggemallim hoil umechamat shehitlia naflu bo hashshevarim hare ze patur. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hammotze bor vechissahu vechazar vegillahu baal habbor chayyav veze haacharon patur. setamo beafar vechazar vehotzi et kol heafar ze haacharon chayyav shekkevan shessetamo beafar nistalleku maase harishon: 
Bor shel shene shuttafin veavar harishon velo kissahu hashsheni velo kissahu harishon chayyav ad sheyyimsor dilyo lashsheni. umishshemmasar dilyo lashsheni lidlot mimmennu niftar harishon venitchayyev hashsheni lechassoto. kissahu harishon uva hashsheni umetzao megulle velo kissahu hashsheni chayyav. vead ematay yihye hashsheni levaddo chayyav. ad sheyyeda harishon shehabbor megulle uchede sheyyiskor poalim veyichrot arazim vichassennu. vechol sheyyamut bo toch zeman ze hare hashsheni levaddo chayyav bo vechol sheyyamut bo achar zeman kaze shenehen chayyavin leshallem shehare shenehen pashu bo: 
Hammoser boro leshomer chayyav binzakav. veim mesaro lecheresh shote vekatan af al pi shehaya mechusse hare habbealim chayyavin shehabbor asuy lehitgallot veellu en bahen daat: 
Hamechasse boro bedilyo shel chavero uva baal haddeli venatal dilyo baal habbor chayyav: 
Echad hachofer bor o shiach o meara o charitz. velamma neemar <small>(Shemot 21 33)</small> "bor" ad sheyyihye bo kede lehamit. vechamma kede lehamit omek asara tefachim aval im haya pachot measara venafal letocho shor o shear behema chayya veof umet patur. veim huzzeku chayyav baal hattakkala nezek shalem: 
Haya omek habbor tisha umehen tefach echad mayim chayyav. shehattefach shel mayim chashuv keomek shene tefachim bayyabbasha. haya amok shemona umehen shene tefachim mayim o shehaya amko shiva umehen shelosha tefachim mayim venafal letocho shor vechayyotze bo umet en mechayyevin oto leshallem. veim tafas hannizzak en motziin miyyado shehaddevarim haellu yesh bahen safek: 
Hachofer bor amok asara tefachim uva acher vehishlimo leesrim uva acher vehishlimo lishloshim kullan chayyavim. chafar harishon pachot measara afillu tefach uva haacharon vehishlimo laasara ben shechafar bo tefach o shehigbiah binyan al sefato tefach ze haacharon chayyav. satam tefach shehosif o shessatar tefach shebbana hare ze safek im kevar nistallek maase rishon o adayin lo nistallek: 
Chafar harishon bor amok uva haacharon vehirchivo venafal letocho shor umet. im mechamat hevlo met haacharon patur shehare miet hevlo veim mechamat chavato met haacharon chayyav shehare hu hikriv hezzek bor ze. vechen im nafal hashshor meoto hatztzad shehirchiv haacharon haacharon chayyav shehare hikriv hezzek bor ze af al pi shemmet min hahevel. veim min hatztzad shechafar harishon nafal harishon chayyav shezze haacharon miet hevlo: 
Bor shechiyyeva alav hattora afillu lo meta habbehema ella mehevlo veen tzarich lomar im meta mechavato. lefichach im haya omek habbor kerachbo en lo hevel. veim lo nechbeta bo habbehema umeta patur. haya amko yeter al rachbo yesh lo hevel veim meta bo habbehema chayyav af al pi shello nechbeta bekarkaitah: 
Asa tel gavoah birshut harabbim venechbeta bo habbehema umeta. im haya gavoah asara tefachim chayyav leshallem. veim haya pachot measara patur al mitat habbehema. aval im huzzeka bilvad chayyav leshallem nezek shalem. vaafillu betel gavoah kol shehu o bachafira kol shehi. shehannezek bechol shehu davar matzuy veyadua veen hammita bechol shehu metzuya vahare hu kemo ones: 
Vechen eno chayyav al mitat habbehema bevor o al chavitatah betel. ella im hayita habbehema ketanna o chereshet o shota o suma o shennafla ballayla. aval im hayta pikkachat venafla bayyom umeta patur shezze kemo ones mippene shedderech habbehema lirot velasur min hammichsholot. vechen im nafal letocho adam umet afillu haya suma o shennafal ballayla ben shehaya ben chorin o eved hare ze patur. veim huzzak bo haadam o habbehema happikkachat chayyav nezek shalem kemo shebbearnu: 
Nafal letocho shor pesule hammukdashin umet hare ze patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 34)</small> "vehammet yihye lo" mi shehammet shello yatza ze shehu asur bahanaa vedino sheyyikkaver: 
Haya chofer babbor venafla habbehema betoch habbor mikkol hachafira umeta. im nafla millefaneha chayyav. meachareha kegon shennivata vechazra al akevah leachor venafla umeta patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 33)</small> "venafal" ad sheyyippol derech nefila. nafla lefaneha mikkol hachafira chutz labbor umeta en bet din mechayyevin oto. veim tafas hannizzak en motziin miyyado. veim nafla laachoreha chutz labbor umeta o huzzeka baal habbor patur: 
Shor sheddachaf behema letoch habbor umeta. im muad hu baal habbor meshallem mechetza uvaal hashshor mechetza. veim tam hu baal hashshor meshallem revia miggufo uvaal habbor meshallem shelosha chalakim min hayyafe shebbinchasav. shebbaal hannevela omer levaal habbor pechat nevela zo yesh li etzlecha af al pi shehi gedola ufikkachat kevan shennidchafa hare zo kemi shennafla ballayla kol sheani yachol lehotzi mibbaal hashshor ani motzi vehashshear atta chayyav leshallemo: 
Vechen hammanniach even al pi habbor uva hashshor venitkal bah venafal labbor umet. hammanniach et haeven meshallem mechetza uvaal habbor mechetza: 
Vechen shor shel hedyot veshel pesule hammukdashin shennagchu keechad. im tam hu ze shel hedyot meshallem chatzi nezek veim muad nezek shalem. shehannizak omer lo kol sheuchal lehotzi mizze otzi vehashshear mimmecha veze hoil vehekdesh hu ufatur atta teshallem li hakkol: 
Mi shehaya chofer bor birshut harabbim venafal alav shor vaharago. baal hashshor patur. veim met hashshor notel baal hashshor deme shoro miyyorshe baal habbor:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 13:
Kelim shennaflu labbor venishtabberu baal habbor patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 33)</small> "venafal shamma shor o chamor" mippi hashshemua lamdu shor velo adam chamor velo kelim. afillu nafal shor bechelav umet hashshor venishtabberu kelav chayyav al habbehema ufatur al hakkelim: 
Habbor meavot nezikin hu vetoldotav kamohu muadin mittechillatan. vechol hammanniach takkala hare zo toledet habbor veim huzzak bah adam o behema meshallem ze shehinniach hattakkala nezek shalem ben hifkir hattakkala ben lo hifkirah. veim huzzeku bah kelim patur: 
Ketzad. hammanniach avno o sakkino o tivno o massao vechayyotze bahen birshut harabbim vehuzzeku bahen ben adam ben behema chayyav nezek shalem. vechen im hinnichan birshuto vehifkir reshuto velo hifkiran nitkal bakkarka venechbat betakkala zo vehuzzak bah chayyav baal hattakkala. veim huzzeku kelim bechol ellu o nittannefu patur: 
Hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut vehirbitz gelalim venittannefu bahen kelav shel baal habbayit patur. shehaggalal ze toledet bor hu velo matzanu bor shechiyyev bo al hakkelim: 
Hammanniach et hakkad birshut harabbim vehalach [hamehallech] venitkal bah ushevarah patur lefi sheen derech bene adam lehitbonen badderech keshehen mehallechin. veim huzzak bah hare baal hakkad chayyav binzakav vaafillu hifkir hakkad. shekkol hammafkir nezakav bemakom sheen lo reshut laasotah mittechilla chayyav keillu lo hifkiran: 
Hinniach et hakkad bemakom sheyyesh lo reshut lehannichah sham kegon mekom hakkeranot shel gittot vechayyotze bahen venitkal bah ushevarah chayyav. veim huzzak bah hamehallech baal hakkad patur mippene shehaya lo lehistakkel. veim hayta afela o shemmille kol hadderech kaddim patur al sheviratah. veim nitkal bah hare baal hakkad chayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Nishbera kaddo birshut harabbim vehuchlak echad bammayim o shellaka bacharaseha patur middine adam lefi sheanus hu. vechayyav bedine shamayim mippene shello sillek hacharasim. vahare hacharasim vehammayim kehefker velo hifkir ella achar shenneenas ulefichach patur. veim nitkavven lizkot bacharaseha vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav. vehu haddin lenafla gemallo velo heemidah vechol kayyotze bah. veim huzzeku kelim bechol ellu patur ben hifkir ben lo hifkir kemo shebbearnu: 
Shene kaddarin shehayu mehallechin badderech ze achar ze venitkal harishon venafal venitkal hashsheni barishon. im haya larishon laamod velo amad chayyav harishon benizke sheni sheaf al pi shehu anus bishat nefila eno anus bihyoto muttal badderech vahare hu yachol laamod. veim lo haya lo laamod patur veaf al pi shello hizhir laze shennitkal bo mippene shehu tarud benafsho: 
Bamme devarim amurim shehu chayyav binzakav shel sheni keshehuzzak gufo shel sheni. aval im huzzeku kelav patur sheeno chayyav al hakkelim babbor vechol takkala toledet bor hu kemo shebbearnu: 
Hakkadarim vehazzaggagim vechayyotze bahen shehayu mehallechin ze achar ze venitkal harishon venafal venitkal hashsheni barishon vehashshelishi bashsheni vechol echad mehen yesh lo laamod velo amad. harishon chayyav benizke gufo shel sheni ben shehuzzak begufo shel rishon hammuttal baaretz ben shehuzzak bemassao. vehashsheni chayyav benizke gufo shel shelishi im huzzak begufo shel sheni. aval im huzzak bemassao shel sheni shennafal patur. shehare omer lo hashsheni bor ze shehu massai en ani hakkore oto shehare harishon hippil hashsheni im massao. veim hizhiru ze et ze kullan peturin: 
Nafal harishon vehaya muttal lerochav hadderech venitkal echad berosho veechad beraglav veechad bevitno hare hu chayyav benizke kullan hoil vehaya lo laamod velo amad: 
Hashshofech et hammayim birshut harabbim vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav binzakav. veim nittanfu kelav patur kemo shebbearnu. nivleu hammayim baaretz venishara haaretz chalaka vehuchlak venafal vehuzzak bakkarka hare ze chayyav binzakav: 
Kol ellu sheppotkin bivotehen vegorfin mearotehen en lahen reshut lishpoch hammayim birshut harabbim bimot hachamma aval bimot haggeshamim yesh lahen reshut. veaf al pi chen im huzzak adam o behema bammayim chayyavin nezek shalem: 
Lo yotzi adam tivno vekashsho lirshut harabbim kede sheyyadushu veyaasu lo zevel. veim hotzi kenasuhu chachamim sheyyihyu kehefker vechol hakkodem bahen zacha meet shenniddoshu vehishbichu. veim kadam adam vezacha bahen mishsheat hotzaa lirshut harabbim en motziin miyyado. veaf al pi shehen kehefker im huzzak bahen adam o behema hare ze hammotzi chayyav leshallem: 
Yesh lechol adam lehotzi et hazzevel vehaggelalim lirshut harabbim bishat hotzaat zevalim velitzbor otan sham sheloshim yom kede sheyyihye nishshof beragle adam [veragle behema]. veaf al pi chen im hizzik chayyav leshallem. vechayyavin al ze haggalal mishshum gezel kevan sheen bo shevach im niddosh lo kansu bo: 
En shorin tit birshut harabbim veen lovnim levenim. aval govlin tit birshut harabbim aval lo levenim: 
Habbone birshut harabbim hammevi avanim mevi vehabbone bone. vechullan shehizziku chayyavin leshallem nezek shalem: 
Hachotzev shechatzav even umesarah lesattat vehuzzak bah adam o behema hassattat chayyav. vesattat shemmasar lechammar hachammar chayyav. masar chammar lechattaf hakkattaf chayyav. masar kattaf levone habbone chayyav. mesarah habbone leze shemmetakken yeshivatah babbinyan hametakken chayyav. veim achar sheheeluha al gabbe haddimos nafla vehizzika vehayu osin bekabbelanut kullan chayyavin. uvischirut haacharon chayyav vechullan peturin: 
Hakkotel vehailan shennaflu lirshut harabbim vehizziku patur milleshallem veaf al pi shehifkiran. lefi sheenan domim labbor shehare en techillatan lehazzik. veim hayu reuin bet din kovin lo zeman lakotz et hailan velistor et hakkotel. vechamma hazzeman sheloshim yom. naflu betoch hazzeman vehizziku patur leachar hazzeman chayyav mippene sheshshiha otan: 
Hammatznia et hakkotz veet hazzechuchit vehaggoder gedero bekotzim vehifriach lirshut harabbim vehuzzak echad bahen chayyav nezek shalem. veim gadar bekotzim betzimtzum betoch reshuto patur lefi sheen derech bene adam lehitchakkech bakketalim: 
Hammatznia kotzav uzechuchiyyotav betoch katlo shel chavero uva baal hakkotel vesatar et katlo venafal lirshut harabbim vehizzik. im kotel raua haya hammatznia chayyav. veim kotel bari hu baal hakkotel chayyav: 
Chasidim harishonim hayu matzniin et hakkotzim veet hazzechuchiyyot betoch sedotehem beomek shelosha tefachim baaretz kede shello taalem hammacharesha. vaacherim sorfim otan beesh. vaacherim mashlichim otan layyam o lannahar kede shello yuzzak bahen adam: 
Lo yesakkel adam mershuto lirshut harabbim. ven osin chalal tachat reshut harabbim velo borot velo shichin velo mearot veaf al pi shehaagala yechola lehallech al gabbehen vehi teuna avanim shemma tippachet millematta shello middato. vehachofer bor letzarche rabbim muttar: 
En motziin zizin ugezuzetraot lirshut harabbim ella im ken hayu lemala miggamal verochvo. vehu shello yaafil hadderech al bene reshut harabbim. veim ratza kones letoch shello umotzio. kanas velo hotzi hare ze motzi kol zeman sheyyirtze. aval eno yachol lehachezir ketalim limkoman leolam. shekkol metzar shehechziku bo rabbim asur lekalkelo: 
Lakach chatzer uvah zizin ugezuzteraot yotzot lirshut harabbim hare zo bechezkatah veim nafla chozer uvone otah keshehayta: 
Ilan shehu note lirshut harabbim kotzetz kede sheyyihye haggamal over berochvo. umannichin makom panuy mishshete siftot hannahar kerochav kitfe hammallachim sheyyordin sham umoshchin hassefina. vechol ilan hannimtza berochav ze kotztzin oto miyyad veen matrin bivalav shehare meakkev moshche hassefina: 
Mi shehayta derech harabbim overet betoch sadehu netalah unetanah lahem min hatztzad ma shennatan natan vezachu bo veze shennatal lo zacha bo. vechamma rochav derech harabbim en pachot mishshesh esre ammot:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 14:
Hammadlik betoch sede chaviro veavra haddeleka [vehizzika] chayyav leshallem nezek shalem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 5)</small> "ki tetze esh umatza kotzim veneechal gadish o hakkama" vegomer shallem yeshallem hammavir vegomer. vehabbeera meavot nezikin hi: 
Hidlik betoch reshuto tzarich leharechik missof hammetzar kede shello taavor haddeleka lisde chavero. vechamma shiur haharchaka hakkol lefi gova haddeleka. veim lo hirchik karauy veavra haesh vehizzika chayyav leshallem nezek shalem. hirchik karauy veavra vehizzika patur shezzo makka bide shamayim hi. vechen im avra nahar o shelulit sheyyesh bahen mayim verachban shemone ammot patur: 
Avra gader omdin gova haggader vegova haddeleka vehaetzim o hakkotzim hammetzuyin sham im enah reuya laavor patur veim reuya laavor chayyav. bamme devarim amurim beesh hakkodachat. aval im haya lah lahav gadol haole venichpaf miggova aliyyat hallahav vehayu etzim metzuyin sham en lah omed ella afillu avra elef amma chayyav: 
Nafla deleka bachatzero venafal gader shello mechamat haddeleka veavra haddeleka bechatzer acheret. im haya yachol ligdor haggader shennafal velo gedaro chayyav. lema haddavar dome leshoro sheyyatza vehizzik shehaya lo leshamro velo shemaro: 
Hashsholeach et habbeera beyad cheresh shote vekatan patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. bamme devarim amurim shemmasar lahen gachelet velibbuha shedderech haggachelet lehikkavot meeleha kodem shettaavor vetadlik. aval im masar lahen shalhevet chayyav shehare maasav garmu: 
Shalach et habbeera beyad pikkeach ze happikkeach shehivir chayyav leshallem vehashsholeach patur. vechen im hinniach shomer lishmor habbeera hashshomer chayyav: 
Echad hevi et haur veechad hevi et haetzim hammevi et haetzim chayyav. echad hevi et haetzim veechad hevi et haur hammevi et haur chayyav. ba acher velibbah hamelabbe chayyav. libbattu ruach sheenah metzuya tamid hare kullan peturin. libba velibbattu haruach chayyav shehare hu garam vechol haggorem lehazzik meshallem nezek shalem min hayyafe shebbannechasim kishar kol hammazzikin: 
Esh sheyyatza veachla etzim o avanim o afar chayyav leshallem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 5)</small> "umatza kotzim" kulei <small>(Shemot 22 5)</small> "o hassade". achla gadish vechayyotze bo vehayu kelim temunim betoch haggadish im hayu kegon morigim uchele bakar vechayyotze bahen middevarim shedderech anshe hassade letamnam baggadish chayyav leshallem. hayu begadim uchele zechuchit vechayyotze bahen patur al hakkelim: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemadlik betoch sede chavero. aval bemadlik betoch shello veavra lisde chavero patur al kol hakkelim hattemunim baggadish aval meshallem hu shiur mekom hakkelim veroin oto keillu hu male gadish shel chittim o shel seorim: 
Hammadlik betoch sede chavero veyatza haesh veneechal haggadish vehaya gedi kafut lo veeved samuch lo venisraf immo chayyav. shekken derech bene adam laasot begadish. haya eved kafut lo ugedi samuch lo venisraf immo patur: 
Hammashil makom lachavero vehigdish bo vehitmin bo kelim vehidlik hammashil vesaraf haggadish eno meshallem ella deme gadish bilvad. hishilo makom lehagedish chittim vehigdish seorim o lehagedish seorim vehigdish chittim o shehigdish chittim vechippam bisorim o shehigdish seorim vechippam bechittim eno meshallem lo ella deme seorim bilvad: 
Hammadlik et habbira shel chavero meshallem kol ma shebbetochah. shekken derech bene adam lehanniach kol kelehem vechol cheftzehem babbattim. vechol sheyyiton baal habbayit hare ze nishba binkitat chefetz venotel. ushevua zo middivre sofrim kemo sheyyitbaer. uvilvad sheyyiton devarim shehu amud bahen o shehu lamud lihyot otan haddevarim shettaan pikkadon etzlo: 
Gamal shehu taun pishtan veover birshut harabbim venichnas pishtano letoch hachanut vedalka benero shel chenvani vehidlik et kol habbira baal haggamal chayyav mippene shehirba bemassooy ben sheamda habbehema ben shello amda. hinniach hachenvani nero mibbachutz hachenvani chayyav af bidme pishtan mippene shehinniach nero mibbachutz. vaafillu ner chanukka haya lo leshev velishmor: 
Hakkofef kamato shel chavero lifne haesh ad shettidlak im en haesh maggaat lah ella beruach sheenah metzuya patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. vehattomen kamato shel chavero beafar o beteven veavra haesh veachla otah hare hattomen patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim mippene shehammadlik et haesh patur al hattamun: 
Esh sheavra vehizzika et haadam vechavla bo hare hammavir chayyav binzakav uveshivto uverippuyo uvetzaaro uvevashto keillu hizziko beyado. sheaf al pi sheishsho mamono hu hare hu kemo shehizzika bechitzav. aval im hizzika behemto o boro et haadam eno chayyav ella benezek bilvad kemo shebbearnu: 
Kol toldot haesh hare hen keesh. ketzad. hinniach even o sakkin o massa berosh gaggo venaflu beruach metzuya vehizziku chayyav leshallem nezek shalem shekkol ellu vechayyotze bahen toldot habbeera hen. veim naflu beruach sheenah metzuya vehizziku patur: seliku lehu hilchot nizke mamon besad
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 1:
Tzaraat or habbasar hu sheyyalbin makom min haor vetihye hallavnunit kikrum betza umikkerum betza ulemala. aval lavnunit shehi diha mikkerum habbetza ulematta enah tzaraat ella bohak hu: 
Vearbaa marot yesh betzaraat or habbasar. veellu hen. loven az beyoter sheen lemala mimmennu shehu nire beor habbasar kesheleg hu hannikra baheret. veloven shehu diha mizze meat shennire ketzemer naki shel keves ben yomo hu hannikra seet. velavan sheddiha min hasseet meat shennire kesid hahechol hu toledet habbaheret venikret sappachat. veloven sheddiha missid hahechol meat vahare hu kikrum betza hi toledet hasseet vegam ze nikra sappachat. hinne lamadta shehammare shehu kesid hahechol hu sappachat habbaheret. vehammare shehu kikrum betza hi sappachat hasseet. sheen leshon sappachat ella tefela. mikkan amru marot negaim shetayim shehen arba baheret vesappachtah seet vesappachtah: 
Arba marot negaim ellu kullan mitztarfin ze im ze ben lehakel ben lehachemir. ben bitchillat reiyyat hannega ben besof hashshiva. ben leachar shenniftar hametzora o nechlat. ketzad. echad nega shehaya kullo lavan kashsheleg o kesid hahechol o ketzemer naki o kikrum betza. veechad nega shehaya miktzat halloven kemare habbaheret umiktzato kemare hasseet umiktzato kemare hassappachat. hakkol kemare echad hu chashuv. im ken lamma menaum chachamim veamru marot negaim shetayim shehen arba kede lehavin bemarot. shekkol kohen sheeno makkir hammarot ushemotehen keshemmelammedin oto umodiin oto lo yire hannega ad sheyyavin veyakkir veyomar zo hi habbaheret vezo hi sappachtah zo hi hasseet vezo hi sappachtah: 
Haya bemare halloven mearba marot ellu miktzat admumiyyot meoravot bo. gam ze nega tzaraat hu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 19)</small> "o vaheret levana adamdamet". vehu haddin liset ulesappachat shel seet ulesappachat habbaheret. vehammare hazze shehu meorav millavnunit umeat odem hu hannikra patuch. vechetzad mare happatuch bearba marot ellu. keillu hen arba kosot meleot chalav venitarev bakkos harishona shene tippe dam uvashsheniyya arbaa tippin uvashshelishit shemone tippin uvarviit shishsha asar tippin. happatuch shebbabbaheret hu hammare harvii vehappatuch shebbasseet kemare kos shelishit vehappatuch shebbesappachat habbaheret kemare hakkos hashsheniyya vehappatuch shebbesappachat hasseet kemare hakkos harishona: 
Kol hammarot haellu ben hallavan ben happatuch mitztarfin ze im ze uchemare echad hen chashuvin. uven shehaya hannega kullo lavan o miktzato lavan umiktzato adamdam hakkol kemare echad hu ben lehakel ben lehachemir: 
Kol mare tzaraat or habbasar enah keruya nega velo metammea ad sheyyihye mare hannega amok meor habbasar. lo amok bimshishato ella bemarit haayin kemare hachamma hanniret laayin amukka min hatztzel. aval im haya mare halloven o happatuch beshave im shear haor o gavoah min haor eno nega ella kemo tzemach min hatztzemachim haolim bagguf: 
Shiur kol nige tzaraat ben tzaraat adam ben tzaraat begadim kigris hakkilki shehu merubba. vehu makom merubba meor habbasar kede tzemichat sheloshim veshesh searot shesh searot orech veshesh searot rochav. vechol happachut mizze eno nega tzaraat: 
Nega shehaya rachbo kede tzemichat chamesh searot afillu haya arko amma hare ze tahor veeno nega tzaraat ad sheyyihye bo ribbua kigris. vechol hashshiurin halacha lemoshe missinay: 
Kol makom shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 19)</small> "baheret" hu haddin lishar arbaa marot shel loven o shel patuch vehu sheyyihye hannega kigris o yeter veyihye amok meor habbasar veze hu sheanu korin oto baheret setam. baheret shehi azza kashsheleg niret beadam shehu lavan keha. uvaheret shehi keha niret bechushi azza. lefichach en meshaarin hakkol ella bevenoni sheeno lo lavan velo shachor: 
Shelosha simane tuma hen betzaraat or habbasar. sear lavan vehammichya vehappisyon. ushelashtan meforashin battora. ketzad. mi shennolda bo baheret uvah sear lavan o michyat basar chay kesheyyirehu hakkohen yachlito veyomar tame. lo haya bah sear lavan velo michya yissager shivat yamim uvashshevii roehu im nolad babbaheret sear lavan o michya o sheppasta vehosifa hare ze muchlat. lo nolad bah lo michya velo sear lavan velo pasta baor yasgir shavua sheni. im nolad bah echad mishshelashtan machlito veim lav hare ze tahor veyifterennu sheen benige or habbasar hesger yeter al shene shavuot. veim leachar sheppetaro vetiher pasa hannega o nolad bo sear lavan o michya hare ze muchlat tuma: 
Baheret shehayta azza kashsheleg uleachar hahesger naaset kikrum betza o shehayta battechilla kikrum betza venaaset kashshaleg hare hi kemot shehayta sheen azzut hammare siman tuma velo kehiyyato siman tohora ella im nitmaet mearba marot venaaset keha mikkerum betza shehare naaset bohak ulefichach tahor. im ken mahu ze shenneemar battora <small>(Vayikra 13 6)</small> "vehinne keha hannega velo fasa hannega baor vetiharo hakkohen". sheim keha mearba marot tahor. vechen im lo keha velo pasa velo nolda bo lo sear lavan velo michya hare ze tahor:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 2:
Sear lavan shehu siman tuma betzaraat en pachot mishshete searot. vechamma yihye arkan kede sheyyihyu nittalot bezug. hayta achat arukka veachat ketzara mishshiur ze. o achat shechora veachat levana. o achat millematta venechleka millemala veniret kishtayim. o shehaya ikkaran mashchir veroshan malbin. hare ze tahor. haya ikkaran malbin veroshan mashchir af al pi shehallavan kol shehu tame: 
Shete searot levanot shehen betoch hannega af al pi sheyyesh sear shachor benehen vehen mefuzzarot achat kan veachat kan hare ellu siman tuma. afillu haya hannega kigris metzumtzam en mekom sear hashshachor memaato. uven shehayu shete hassearot betoch habbaheret vehi makkaftan uven shehayu besofah hare ze tame. aval im hayu betziddah mibbachutz hare ze tahor ad sheyyihye haor shetztzomchot shete hassearot hallevanot lavan. hayu shete searot betoch hannega veshochvot chutza lo tame. hayu chutza lo veshochvot betocho enan siman tuma: 
Loven hassearot metamme bechol mare ben shehayu levanot kashsheleg ben shehayu levanot loven dahe beyoter hoil umarehen lavan tame: 
En sear lavan siman tuma ad sheyyihye beguf habbaheret. ketzad. baheret uvetochah shechin o michva o bohak o michyat hashshechin o michyat hammichva ushete searot levanot betoch hashshechin o hammichva o habbohak shebbetoch hannega enan siman tuma vahare zo kevaheret sheen bah sear lavan veyasgir af al pi shehabbaheret makkefet et hashshechin o et hammichva o et michyatan o et habbohak sheyyesh bahen shete hassearot. vechen im haya shechin o michva o michyatan o bohak makkif et shete hassearot hare ellu enan siman tuma vahare habbaheret kevaheret sheen bah sear lavan veyasgir: 
Halchu lahen hashshechin vehabbohak vehammichva shehikkifu et hassearot hallevanot o nismachin lahen o cholkin otan. venimtzeu shete hassearot betoch habbaheret begufah besof hashshavua harishon o besof hashshavua hashsheni hare ze muchlat. veim lo halchu lahen yifterennu: 
En sear lavan siman tuma ad shettakdim habbaheret et hassear hallavan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 10)</small> "vehi hafcha sear lavan" shettahafoch oto habbaheret. aval im kadam sear lavan et habbaheret hare hi kevaheret sheen bah siman tuma veyasgir: 
Hayta bo baheret uvah sear lavan vehuchlat bo veachar kach halcha habbaheret vehinnicha sear lavan bimkomo vetiher veachar kach chazra baheret acheret bimkom habbaheret harishona vahare hassear lavan betochah zehu hannikra sear pekudda. eno siman tuma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 10)</small> "vehi hafcha sear lavan" shehafachattu hi lo shehafachattu chavertah: 
Haya bo baheret kigris uvah shete searot vehuchlat vehalach mimmenna kachatzi geris vetiher venisharu shete hassearot bachatzi geris hannishar vechazar kachatzi geris bimkom ze shehalach vahare shete searot levanot babbaheret kigris enan siman tuma ad sheyyahafoch shete hassearot baheret achat: 
Baheret kachatzi geris veen bah kelum venolda betziddah baheret kachatzi geris uvah sear achat hare zo lehasegir. baheret kachatzi geris uvah sear achat venolda lah baheret kachatzi geris uvah sear achat hare zo lehasegir. baheret kachatzi geris uvah shete searot venolda lah baheret kachatzi geris uvah saara achat hare zo lehasegir. baheret kachatzi geris veen bah kelum venolda lah baheret kachatzi geris uvah shete searot hare zo lehachelit shehare kadma baheret lishte hassearot hallevanot. safek sear lavan kadam sefek habbaheret kadma hare zo tame. veyerae li shettumato besafek:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 3:
En hammichya siman tuma ad shettihye kaadasha merubbaat o yeter al ze. vechamma shiurah kede tzemichat arba searot shetayim orech ushetayim rochav. vehu shettihye hammichya beemtza habbaheret vehabbaheret makkefet otah mikkol tzad vehi yetera al hammichya rochav shete searot o yeter. aval im hayta hammichya betzad habbaheret enah siman tuma. hayta mefuzzeret kegon shehaya basar chay kechardal bemakom ze uvasar chay kechardal bemakom acher af al pi shehakkol beemtza habbaheret enan mitztarfin lechaadasha. ad sheyyihye bemakom echad beemtza habbaheret kaadasha merubba o yeter: 
Hammichya metammea bechol mare ben shehaya mare hammichya adom o shachor o lavan vehu shello yihye halloven mearba hammarot shebbearnu: 
En hammichya siman tuma ad shettihye begufah shel baheret. ketzad. baheret shehayta beemtza shechin o michva o michya o bohak. vehammichya betoch hashshechin o betoch hammichva o betoch michyatan o betoch habbohak. af al pi shehammichya beemtza habbaheret enah siman tuma mippene shehi betoch hashshechin o hammichva o betoch habbohak o michyatan. vechen im hikkif hashshechin et michyato vehammichva et michyatah vehabbohak et hammichya o shennismach echad mehen lammichya mitztziddah o shechalak echad mehen et hammichya venichnas letochah enah siman tuma vahare zo kevaheret sheen bah siman veyasgir. halchu lahen hashshechin o hammichva o habbohak shehaya tachat hammichya shehayu betziddah o shehayu makkifin o shehayu nichnasin letochah venimtzet hammichya levaddah betoch habbaheret besof shavua rishon o besof shavua sheni hare ze yachlit. im lo halchu lahen yiftor: 
Hammichya siman tuma leolam ben shekkadma michya et habbaheret ben shekkadma baheret et hammichya lefi shello neemar bah vehi hafcha. ze shenneemar battora <small>(Vayikra 13 10)</small> "vehi hafcha sear lavan umichyat basar chay basseet" eno tzarich lishnehen lesear ulemichya ella kol echad mehen siman tuma. velo neemar sear lavan im hammichya ella litten shiur lemichya shettihye kede lekabbel sear lavan shehu shete searot: 
Baheret kigris metzumtzam uveemtzaah michya kaadasha metzumtzemet hare ze muchlat. nitmaata habbaheret o shennitmaata hammichya tahor vechen im ravta hammichya shebbetoch baheret zo tahor sheen habbaheret metamma bemichya ad shettihye yetera al hammichya rochav shete searot mikkol tzad. hayta hammichya pechuta mikkaadasha veravta hammichya ad shennaaset kaadasha hare ze muchlat. nitmaata hammichya mimma shehayta o shehalcha lah hare zo kemot shehayta veen kan siman tuma: 
Baheret yetera mikkigris uvah michya yetera mikkaadasha verabbu o shennitmaatu tame. uvilvad shello yitmaet baheret mikkigris velo titmaet hammichya mikkaadasha velo tikrav hammichya lesof habbaheret befachot mikkede tzemichat shete searot kemo shebbearnu: 
Baheret kigris uvasar chay kaadasha o yeter makkifah mibbachutz uvaheret sheniyya makkefet et habbasar hachay. hare habbaheret happenimit lehasegir shehare en bah siman tuma uvaheret hachitzona lehachelit shehare hammichya beemtzaah. nitmaet habbasar hachay shebbenehen o shehalach kullo ben shehaya mitmaet vechale mibbifnim ben shehaya mitmaet mibbachutz hare shetehen kevaheret achat sheen bah siman tuma: 
Baheret shehayta berosh evar min haevarim vehammichya beemtza habbaheret berosh haevar enah siman tuma mippene shehammichya choleket et hannega venimtza miktzato shofea veyored mikkan umiktzato shofea veyored mikkan veneemar bingaim veraahu hakkohen sheyyihye roe hannega kullo keachat. veellu hen rashe evarim sheenam mittammein bemichya. rashe etzbeot yadayim veraglayim verashe aznayim verosh hachotem verosh haatara verashe dadin shel ishsha. aval rashe dadin shel ish vehayyibbolet vehaddildulin mittammein bemichya: 
Vechol rashe evarim ellu shehaya mekoman yoshev kigris mittammein bingaim. aval im hayu agullin kerov beriyyat bene adam tehorin. ketzad. baheret kigris berosh chatmo o berosh etzbao shofaat elach veelach tahor shenneemar veraahu hakkohen ad sheyyirehu kullo keachat:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 4: Happisyon metamme bechol shehu vehu sheyyihye happisyon meachat mimmarot hannegaim. aval im haya happisyon mare bohak eno pisyon. veen happisyon siman tuma ad sheyyifse chutz lannega aval im pasa letoch hannega hare hu kemot shehaya. ketzad. baheret uvetochah basar chay pachot mikkaadasha vehisgirah uvesof hashshavua nitmaata hammichya mimma shehayta o shehalach habbasar hachay kullo en ze pisyon. sheen habbaheret posa letochah ella chutza lah:
En happisyon siman tuma ad sheyyihye achar hesger. aval im ba battechilla veraa hakkohen et hannega shehu pose veholech eno machlito ella masgiro ad sof hashshavua veyerae:

En habbaheret posa letoch hashshechin velo letoch hammichva. velo letoch michyat hashshechin velo letoch michyat hammichva. velo larosh velo lazzakan af al pi shennikrechu vehalach hassear mehen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 7)</small> "veim paso tifse hammispachat baor". aval baheret sheppasta letoch habbohak hare ze pisyon:

Hashshechin vehammichva vehabbohak umichyat hashshechin umichyat hammichva shehen cholkin ben haom lappisyon eno siman tuma. hisgiro vehalchu lahen ad shennimtza happisyon samuch laom hare ze muchlat:

Baheret kigris ufasta kachatzi geris veod vehalach min haom kachatzi geris. af al pi shehannotar min haom im happisyon yeter mikkigris [hare] ze tahor. hayta kigris ufasta kigris veod vehalcha lah haom terae battechilla veyasgir shavua achar shavua. hayta bo baheret vehisgiro vehalcha habbaheret besof yeme hesger vechazra baheret bimkomah kemot shehayta hare hu kemo shehaya. nitmaata [betoch yeme hesger] ufasta vechazra kemot shehayta o sheppasta venitmaet happisyon vechazra kemot shehayta hare ze yasgir o yiftor:

Baheret kigris ufasta kigris venolad bappisyon michya o sear lavan vehalcha lah haom terae battechilla. hayta bo baheret kigris vehisgiro. besof hashshavua vahare hi kesela, safek shehi hi safek shehi acheret, baa tachteha hare ze tame:

Baheret kigris vechut yotze mimmennu im yesh bo rochav shete searot zokkah lesear lavan ulefisyon aval lo lemichya sheen hammichya siman tuma ad shettakkif otah habbaheret veyihye ben sof hammichya vesof habbaheret rochav tzemichat shete searot. hayu shete beharot vechut yotze mizzo lazo im yesh bo rochav shete searot metzarfan veim lav eno metzarfan. hisgiro shavua achar shavua velo nolad lo siman tuma ufetaro uleachar happittur pasa hannega kol shehu hare ze muchlat:
Baheret shettahara mittoch hesger o mittoch hechlet shehalchu mimmenna simane tuma en masgirin bah leolam:
Baheret shekkansa achar happittur ufasta lichmot shehayta o sheppasta vechazra lichmot shehayta hare hu betohorato:

Baheret kigris uvah michya kaadasha vesear lavan betoch hammichya vehechlito uleachar hechlet halcha hammichya tame mippene sear lavan. halach hassear lavan tame mippene hammichya. haya hassear lavan betoch habbaheret vehalach lo tame mippene hammichya. halcha hammichya tame mippene sear lavan:

Baheret uvah michya ufisyon. halcha hammichya tame mippene happisyon. halach happisyon tame mippene hammichya. vechen besear lavan uvefisyon. hechlito besear lavan vehalach hassear vechazar bo sear lavan acher. o shennolda lo michya o pisyon. o shehechlito bemichya vehalcha hammichya venolda lo michya acheret. o sear lavan o pisyon. o shehechlito befisyon vehalach happisyon vechazar bo pisyon acher. o shennolda bah michya o sear lavan. hare ze betumato kemot shehaya. echad hattame shehuchlat battechilla o shehuchlat besof shavua rishon o besof shavua sheni o achar happittur. hoil vehuchlat mikkol makom eno tahor ad shello yishshaer bo siman tuma lo siman hechlet velo siman acher:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 5: Mi shehayta lo makka beor besaro venifshat haor mechamat hammakka. im hayta hammakka mechamat haesh kegon shennichva begachelet o beremetz o bevarzel o beeven shellibbeno baesh vechayyotze bahen hare zo nikret michva. veim hayta hammichva shello mechamat haesh. ben shellaka beeven o beetz vechayyotze bahen ben shehayta hammichva mechamat choli hagguf kegon garav o chazazit shehifsid haor o shachefet o kaddachat vedalleket vechayyotze bahen shehishchitu haor hare ze nikra shechin:
Libben shippud vehikka bo im haya rosho (mevoraz) [kaddur] hare zo michva. veim haya rosho chad hare zo safek im hi michva o shechin. laka beme teverya o begefet vechayyotze bahen hare ze shechin:

Hashshechin vehammichva kol zeman shehen makkot teriyyot hen nikrain mordin veenan mitammein bingaim kelal. chayu hashshechin vehammichva venitrappeu rippuy gamur af al pi shehammakom tzalleket veenah doma lishar haor hare hen keor habbasar lechol davar umittammein bishlosha simanin veyesh bahen hesger shene shavuot kemo shebbearnu:

Hitchilu hashshechin vehammichva lichyot ulehitrappeot venaaset alehen kelippa kiklippat hashshum. zo hi <small>(Vayikra 13 23)</small> "tzarevet hashshechin" haamura battora <small>(Vayikra 13 24)</small> "umichyat hammichva" haamura sham. umetammeot bishne simanin besear lavan o befisyon veen bahen hesger ella shavua echad. ketzad. baheret shehayta betzarevet hashshechin o bemichyat hammichva im haya bah sear lavan yachlit. lo haya bah sear lavan yasgir shavua echad veyerae besof hashshavua im nolad bah sear o pasta yachlit veim lo nolad bah kelum yiftor. pasta leachar happittur o nolad bah sear lavan yachlit:

Hashshechin vehammichva en mitztarfin ze im ze lefichach chillekan hakkatuv lomar sheen mitztarfin ze im ze veen posin ze laze veen posin leor habbasar velo baheret or habbasar posa letochan. ketzad. haya shechin betzad hammichva uvaheret kigris bishtehen hare ze tahor. hayta beachat mehen ufasta lashsheniyya o sheppasta leor habbasar tahor. hayta baheret beor habbasar ufasta leachat mehen eno pisyon. haya betoch kappo tzarevet shechin kigris uvah baheret kigris yasgir sheaf al pi sheenah reuya lesear lavan velo lefisyon shemma yivvaled lo shechin acher betziddah vetifse letocho:

Shechin shennaasa michva bittela michva et hashshechin. umichva shennaaset shechin bittel shechin hammichva. im en yadua im shechin haya im michva en bechach kelum sheshshenehem siman echad vetuma achat velo chillekan hakkatuv ella lomar sheen mitztarfin:
Hisgiro bevaheret shebbashshechin uvesof hashshavua naasa or habbasar. o shehisgiro beor habbasar uvesof hashshavua naaset shechin yerae battechilla:

Mi shennashar kol sear rosho ben mechamat choli ben mechamat makka sheenah reuya legaddel sear ben sheachal devarim hammashshirin et hassear o sach devarim shehishshiru searo af al pi sherauy legaddel leachar zeman hoil veavad kol sear rosho atta hare ze nikra kereach o gibbeach. im nashar searo min hakkadkod ulematta shofea leachor vead pika shel tzavvar nikra kereach. veim nashar min hakkadkod ulematta shofea lefanav ad keneged paddachto nikra gibbeach:

Hakkarachat vehaggabbachat metammeot bishne simanin bemichya uvefisyon. veyesh bahen hesger shene shavuot shenneemar bahen <small>(Vayikra 13 43)</small> "kemare tzaraat or basar". ulefi sheen bahen sear en hassear hallavan siman tuma bahen. vechetzad metammein bishne simanin uvishte shavuot. sheim hayta baheret bekarachto o begabbachto vehayta bah michya yachlit. lo hayta bah michya yasgir veyire besof hashshavua im nolda bah michya o pisyon yachlit. lo nolad bah kelum yasgir shavua sheni. pasat o shennolad bah michya yachlit lo nolad bah kelum yiftor. veim pasat o nolad bah michya leachar happittur yachlit:

Hakkarachat vehaggabbachat enan mitztarfot zo im zo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 42)</small> "bekarachto o begabbachto" melammed shehen shetayim veen posot mizzo lezo velo lishar or habbasar velo baheret or habbasar posa letochan:

Hakkarachat o haggabbachat o hazzakan shennikrach venaasa bahen shechin o michva metammein kishchin uchemichva shebbeor habbasar. sheharosh o hazzakan shennikrechu keor habbasar lechol davar ella sheen mittammein besear lavan. harosh vehazzakan kodem sheyyitzmach bahen hassear vaadayin lo heelu sear meolam vechen haddildulin shebbarosh veshebbazzakan hare hen keor habbasar umittammein bishlosha simanin ushene shavuot. vechen zekan haishsha vehassaris ad shello heelu sear hare hen keor habbasar. veim heelu sear hare hen kizkan haish shemmittamme bintakin kemo sheyyitbaer veeno mittamme bevaheret:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 6: Elu mekomot baadam sheen mittammein bevaheret. toch haayin vetoch haozen vetoch hachotem vetoch happe vehakkematim shebbabbeten vehakkematim shebbatztzavar vetachat haddad uvet hashshechi vechaf haregel vehatztzipporen veharosh vehazzakan sheyyesh bahen sear vehashshechin vehammichva hammordin. kol ellu hammekomot en mittammein bingaim veen mitztarfin bingaim. velo hannega pose letochan. veen mittammein mishshum michya. veen meakkevin et hahofech kullo lavan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 2)</small> "veor besaro". vechol ellu eno or galuy ella mehen sheeno or umehen shehu or vehu mechusse veeno galuy. veodem hassefatayim niddon kevet hassetarim veeno mittamme bingaim:

Harosh vehazzakan shennashar kol saaran vehashshechin vehammichva shealu tzarevet mittammein bevaheret kemo shebbearnu. veenan mitztarfin ze im ze veen nega or habbasar pose letocham veenan mittammeim mishshum michya aval meakkevin et hahofech kullo lavan:

Baheret hassemucha larosh o laayin o laozen vechayyotze bahen o lashshechin o lammichva tehora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 3)</small> "veraa hakkohen et hannega beor habbasar" sheyyihye kol shechutza lanega beor habbasar verauy lefisyon:

Ellu beharot tehorot. akkum shehayta bo baheret venitgayyer. hayta beubbar venolad. bekemet venigla. barosh uvazzakan keshehaya bahen sear venikrechu venashar kol hassear venitgalleta habbaheret. hayta bashshechin uvammichva keshehen mordin veheelu tzarevet hare ellu tehorot. vechen im hayta habbaheret barosh o bazzakan kodem sheyyaalu sear meolam veheelu sear vehalach hassear. o shehayta habbaheret baor venaasa mekomah shechin o michva vechayu vahare hen keor habbasar. af al pi shettechillatah vesofah temein hoil vehayta tehora bentayim hare zo tehora. nishtannu marehen ben sheheezzu o shekkahu yerae battechilla. ketzad. akkum shehayta bo baheret kikrum betza uleachar shennitgayyer naaset kashsheleg. o shehayta kashsheleg uleachar shennitgayyer naaset kikrum betza. terae battechilla. vechen bekatan shennolad. uvakkemet shennigla. uvarosh uvazzakan shennikrechu. uvashshechin uvammichva shechayu. im nishtanna mare otan habbeharot yerau battechilla veim lav tehorot:

Kol sefek negaim chutz mishshene sefekot shemmaninu kevar tahor ad shello nizkak letuma. aval mishshennizkak letuma sefeko tame. ketzad. shenayim shebbau etzel kohen baze baheret kigris uvaze kesela vehisgiran uvesof hashshavua haya baze kesela uvaze kesela veen yadua beeze mehen pasta. ben bishne anashim ben beish echad hare ze tahor. sheaf al pi shevvadday pasa hannega baze hoil veeno yadua e zo hi habbaheret sheppasta hare ze tahor ad sheyyeda bee ze nega timmeo:

Mishshennizkak letuma sefeko tame. ketzad. shenayim shebbau etzel kohen baze baheret kigris uvaze kesela vehisgiram besof hashshavua vahare baze kesela veod uvaze kesela veod shenehen temein. chazru shenehen lihyot kesela shehare halach happisyon meechad mehen hoil veeno yadua e zehu shenehen temeim ad sheyyachzeru shenehen lihyot kigris. vezehu sheamru mishshennizkak letuma sefeko tame. vechen mi shehayta bo baheret uvah sear lavan shekkadam et habbaheret vesear lavan shehafachattu habbaheret. veeno yadua ze shekkadam mizze shennehpach. im mittoch hesger nistappek lo hare ze tahor. veim achar hechlet hare ze tame. af al pi shehalach sear echad mehen veeno yodea e ze halach im hassear shehaya siman tuma o hassear haacher:

Mi shebba etzel kohen veraahu shetztzarich hesger o shehu patur vead shello hisgiro o petaro noldu lo simane tuma. hare ze yachlit. vechen im raahu sheyyesh bo simane tuma vekodem sheyyachlito veyomar lo tame atta halchu lahen simane tuma. im haya battechilla o besof shavua rishon yasgiro. veim haya besof shavua sheni o leachar happittur yiftor oto:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 7: Mi shehayta bo baheret vehuchlat beechad missimane tuma ben battechilla ben achar hesger. o shehusgar veachar kach parcha hatztzaraat bechullo venehpach lavan. ben shennehpach mittoch hesger ben mittoch hechlet hare ze tahor. aval im husgar velo nolad lo siman tuma veniftar uleachar happittur parcha hatztzaraat bechullo hare ze tame muchlat:

Habba battechilla vehu kullo hafach lavan. im hayta bo michya o shete searot levanot machlitin oto. im en sham siman tuma masgirin oto shavua rishon. nolad lo sear lavan o michya machlito. lo nolad bo kelum masgiro shavua sheni. lo nolad lo siman tuma hare ze tahor. sheddin baheret zo haggedola kedin hakketanna. hechlito besear lavan shennolad bo vehishchiru shetehen o achat mehen. hiktziru shetehen o achat mehen. nismach hashshechin lishtehen o leachat mehen. hikkif hashshechin et shetehen o achat mehen. o shechillekan hashshechin umichyat hashshechin vehammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak. hare ze tahor. nolad lo sear lavan acher o michya hare ze tame mippene shebba kullo lavan battechilla. echad shepparcha hatztzaraat bechullo keachat veechad sheppasta ufarcha meat meat ad shehilbin kullo. im mittoch hesger o mittoch hechlet tahor. veim achar happittur tame. veim battechilla yasgir. echad shehaya kullo mare echad o shehaya kullo lavan bearba hammarot shebballoven uvearba shel patuch hakkol mitztarfin ben letaharo ben letammeo kemo shebbearnu:

Hayta bo baheret kigris uvah michya kaadasha vehuchlat bemichya ufarcha hatztzaraat bechullo veachar kach halcha hammichya. o shehalcha hammichya techilla veachar kach parcha bechullo. hare ze tahor vaafillu nolad lo sear lavan. nolda bo michya tame shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 14)</small> "uveyom heraot bo basar chay yitma". vehu shettihye kaadasha merubbaat o yeter. hayta bo baheret uvah sear lavan vehuchlat besear lavan veachar kach parcha bechullo af al pi shessear lavan bimkomo omed tahor. shenneemar uveyom heraot bo basar chay yitma bemichya mittamme ze shennehpach kullo lavan achar hechlet o achar hesger. veeno mittamme besear lavan. hechlito befisyon veachar kach pasta ufarcha bechullo tahor. veim niret bo michya tame:

Af rashe evarim sheenan mittammein mishshum michya shebbetoch habbaheret mittammein umeakkevin et hannehpach kullo lavan. ketzad. muchlat o musgar shehilbin kullo betzaraat chutz mikkaadasha basar chay afillu berosh etzbao o berosh chatmo vechayyotze bahen hare hu betumato. vechen ze shennehpach kullo lavan vetahar im chazar bo kaadasha basar chay afillu berosh echad min haevarim hare ze muchlat. nehpach kullo lemare tzaraat chutz mikkaadasha afillu berosh echad min haevarim shennehpach levohak hare ze tame muchlat shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 13)</small> "vehinne chisseta hatztzaraat", lo habbohak. afillu hayta miktzat haadasha basar chay umiktzatah bohak hare zo siman tuma. nehpach kullo lemare tzaraat vetihar veachar kach chazar bo basar kemare habbohak hare ze tahor ad sheyyerae bo kaadasha basar chay shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 14)</small> "uveyom heraot bo basar chay", lo bohak. chazar bo kaadasha miktzatah basar chay umiktzatah bohak eno siman tuma vahare hu betohorato:

Kol tame shepparcha hatztzaraat bechullo tahor. nitgalla mimmennu kaadasha basar chay nitma. chazar venitkassa betzaraat tahor. chazar venitgalla nitma afillu mea peamim. hitchil habbasar hachay lehitgallot vahare hu mosif veholech vehatztzaraat mitmaetet hare ze betumato ad shettitmaet habbaheret mikkigris:

Kol harauy littamme benega habbaheret meakkev hahofech kullo lavan vechol sheeno rauy littamme benega habbaheret eno meakkev. ketzad. parcha bechullo aval lo barosh uvazzakan bashshechin uvammichva hammordin. o shennishar pachot mikkaadasha basar chay samuch lashshechin velammichva hammordin velarosh velazzakan hare ze tahor. chazar harosh vehazzakan venikrechu vechen im chayu hashshechin vehammichva veheelu tzarevet hare ze tame ad shettifrach hatztzaraat bahen shehare hen reuyin levaheret. hayu bah shete beharot achat yesh bah siman tuma veachat tehora ufarcha hattehora lattemea veachar kach parcha bechullo hare ze tahor mippene shehaya muchlat betuma af al pi shehattehora hi shepparcha. velo od ella afillu hayu achat bisfato haelyona veachat bisfato hattachtona o bishte etzbeotav o bishne rise enav ucheshehen nidbakin ze laze nirin shete habbeharot kevaheret achat hoil ufarcha bechullo tahor:

Yesh mare nigo lechohen veniskar mippene shehikdim lehareoto velo nitacher. veyesh mare umafsid. ketzad. mi shehaya muchlat vehalchu lahen simane tuma velo hispik lehareoto lakkohen ad shepparcha bechullo tahor. veillu kadam vehera lakkohen ufetaro kodem sheyyahafoch venehpach achar happittur haya muchlat kemo shebbearnu. hayta bo baheret veen bah kelum velo hispik lehareoto lakkohen ad shepparcha bechullo hare ze tame vetzarich hesger. veillu kadam vehera lakkohen vehisgiro kodem sheyyahafoch venehpach mittoch hesger haya tahor kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 8: Nige harosh vehazzakan hu sheyyippol hassear shebbahen meikkaro veyishshaer mekom hassear panuy veze hu hannikra netek. veen netek pachot mikkigris hamerubba ben shehaya marehu amok ben shello haya amok. velo neemar amok bintakin ella lomar lecha ma mare amok bide shamayim af netek hammitame bide shamayim lehotzi shennitteko adam shehu tahor. vehaishsha vehassaris sheheela zekanam sear hare ze mittamme bintakim:

Hannetakin mitammein bishne simanim besear tzahov dak uvefisyon veyesh bahen hesger shene shavuot vechol ze meforash battora. ketzad. mi shennolad lo netek berosho o bizkano im hayu bo shete searot tzehubbot dakkot velo yoter veen sham bannetek sear shachor kelal yachlit. lo haya bo sear lo shachor velo tzahov yasgir shavua echad uvashshevii roehu im nolad bo sear tzahov dak o sheppasa hannetek yachlit noldu bo shete searot shechorot yiftor oto. lo pasa velo nolad bo sear tzahov velo sear shachor yegalleach sevivot hannetek velo yegalleach hannetek veyasgir shavua sheni vechozer veroehu besof shavua sheni. im pasa hannetek o nolad bo sear tzahov dak yachlit. lo nolad bo kelum yiftor sheen hesger bintakin yeter al shene shavuot. veim achar sheppetaro nolad bo sear tzahov o pasa yachlit:

Ketzad megallechin et hannetek. megalleach chutza lo umanniach shete searot samuch lo kede sheyyihye nikkar happisyon. vetiglachto keshera bechol adam shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 33)</small> "vehitgallach" vechen keshera bechol davar vaafillu haya nazir hare ze megalleach. hisgiro velo gillecho hare ze musgar:

<small>(Vayikra 13 30)</small> "sear tzahov" haamur battora hu sheyyihye ketavnit hazzahav. veze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 30)</small> "dak" hu sheyyihye katzar aval im haya aroch af al pi shehu tzahov ketavnit hazzahav eno siman tuma:

Shete searot hatztzehubbot haddakkot siman tuma. ben shehayu zo betzad zo ben shehayu meruchakot zo mizzo. ben shehayu beemtza hannetek ben shehayu besof hannetek. ben shekkadam hannetek et hassear hatztzahov ben shekkadam hassear hatztzahov et hannetek. hare hu siman tuma. vehu sheyyihyu nittalot bezug kemo shebbearnu bassear hallavan:

Hassear hashshachor hammatztzil bintakin en pachot mishshete searot. veenan matztzilot ad sheyyihyu arkan kede lachof roshan leikkaran. ben shehayu zo betzad zo ben shehayu mefuzzarot vehu sheyyihyu beemtza hannetek veyishshaer min hannetek panuy ben hassear hashshachor shebbetocho uven hassear shechutza lo kede tzemichat shete searot. aval im nisharu hashshete searot hashshechorot betzad hannetek besofo enan matztzilot. ketzad matztzilot. sheim nishar betoch hannetek shete searot shechorot af al pi shennolda bannetek sear tzahov dak o sheppasa hare ze tahor. hechlito besear tzahov o befisyon vetzamach bannetek shete searot shechorot tiher hannetek umatztzilot miyyad happisyon umiyyad hassear hatztzahov. ben shetztzamchu beemtza hannetek ben shetztzamchu besofo. shehatztzomeach matztzil bechol makom vehannishar eno matztzil ad sheyyihye rachok min hakkama shete searot:
Shete searot shetztzamchu achat shechora veachat levana o tzehubba achat arukka veachat ketzara enan matztzilot:

Netek shehuchlat besear tzahov o befisyon venolad bo sear shachor vetiher. af al pi shehalach hassear hashshachor hare ze tahor ad sheyyivvaled bo sear tzahov acher o yifse pisyon acher meachar shehalach hassear hashshachor. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 37)</small> "nirpa hannetek tahor hu" kevan shennitrappe tahor hu af al pi shessimane tuma bimkoman:

Hechlito besear tzahov ben shehechlito battechilla ben shehechlito besof shavua rishon o besof shavua sheni o shehechlito achar happittur vehalach hassear hatztzahov venolad bo sear tzahov acher o shennolad lo pisyon hare ze muchlat keshehaya. vechen im hechlito befisyon ben besof shavua rishon o besof shavua sheni o achar happittur vehalach happisyon vechazar pisyon acher o shennolad lo sear tzahov hare ze muchlat keshehaya ad shello yishshaer siman tuma o ad sheyyatzmiach bo shete searot shechorot:

Shene netakim ze betzad ze veshita shel sear shachor mafseket benehen venifratz hassear hashshachor (venittak) mimmakom echad hare hu kemot shehaya shehassear hashshachor hannishar benehen hare hu betzad hannetek. nifretza hashshitta mishshene mekomot tahor shehare hannishar min hashshitta beemtza hannetek. vechamma yihye bechol pirtza mehen. en pachot mimmekom tzemichat shete searot. veim hayta pirtza mimmakom echad kigris hare ze tame shehappirtza atzmah netek acher. vahare sear shachor betziddo veeno kanus letocho. netek shehassear hashshachor makkifo venetek acher makkif et hassear hashshachor. nifratz hassear shebbenehen mimmakom echad tame shehannetek happenimi lo nitztzal shehare hassear hashshachor betziddo lo betocho. nifratz hassear mishshene mekomot tahor vaafillu hayta pirtza kigris. shehare hannetek happenimi vehachitzon naasu netek echad vesear shachor baemtza. vehu shettihye happirtza kede tzemichat shete searot o yeter:

Netek shehaya chut yotze mimmennu vechen shene netakin shechut yotze mizze laze. im yesh berochav hachut hannatuk kede tzemichat shete searot zokkin littamme besear tzahov dak ufisyon umatztzilin batztzomeach bo. aval sear shachor hannishar beoto hachut eno matztzil ad sheyyihye rochav hachut kigris:

Mi shehaya berosho netek kigris ufasa hannetek [al] kol rosho velo nishar sham sear kelal ella pachot mishshete searot hare ze tahor. ben shennittak kullo mittoch hesger o mittoch hechlet o achar happittur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 40)</small> "kereach hu tahor hu". vechen im haya hannetek bizkano venittak kol zekano hare ze tahor. veaf al pi sheen ze meforash battora shebbichtav kabbala hi sheim halach kol sear hazzakan tahor hu. veyittamme or hazzakan shekkarach benige or habbasar kemo shebbearnu:

Habba battechilla vechol rosho natuk o kol zekano natuk yasgir shavua echad. im lo nolad lo sear tzahov yasgir shavua sheni. im nolad lo sear tzahov dak tame. lo nolad lo yippater. nolad lo achar happittur sear tzahov hare ze muchlat. nolad lo sear shachor hare ze tahor. habba kullo natuk rosh o zakan venolad lo sear shachor tahor kemo shebbearnu. halach hassear hashshachor tame mishshum pisyon:

Harosh vehazzakan enan meakkevin ze et ze veenan mitztarfin ze im ze veen posin mizze laze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 30)</small> "tzaraat harosh o hazzakan" melammed shehen chashuvin shenayim. vee zehu zakan. mehapperek shel lechi haelyon ad pika shel gerogeret. moteach et hachut meozen leozen. kol shemmin hachut ulemala hare hu mikkelal harosh. umin hachut ulematta mikkelal hazzakan:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 9:
Hakkol mittammein bingaim afillu katan ben yomo vehaavadim aval lo akkum velo ger toshav. vehakkol kesherin lirot et hannegaim. vechol hannegaim adam roe otan chutz minnige atzmo: 
Af al pi shehakkol kesherin lirot negaim hattuma vehattohora teluya bechohen. ketzad. kohen sheeno yodea lirot hechacham roehu veomer lo emor tame vehakkohen omer tame. emor tahor vehakkohen omer tahor. hasegiro vehu masgiro. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 5)</small> "veal pihem yihye kol riv vechol nega". vaafillu haya hakkohen katan o shote hechacham omer lo vehu machlit o poter o soger. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hakkohen somech al divre hechacham. aval im haya hakkohen roe vesomech al atzmo asur lo lirot nega mikkol negaim ad sheyyorennu rabbo veyihye baki bechol hannegaim uvishmotehen benige adam kullam uvenige begadim uvenige battim: 
Kohen shettimme et hattahor o tiher et hattame lo asa kelum shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 44)</small> "tame hu" <small>(Vayikra 13 44)</small> "vetimmeo hakkohen" <small>(Vayikra 13 37)</small> "tahor hu" <small>(Vayikra 13 37)</small> "vetiharo hakkohen". umetzora shennirpa ben mittoch hesger ben mittoch hechlet afillu achar kamma shanim hare ze betumato ad sheyyomar lo kohen tahor atta: 
En hakkohen rashshay letamme et hattame ad sheyyihyu enav bimkom hannega beor habbasar shechutza lo. vechohen sheraa hannega battechilla hu sheroehu besof shavua rishon uvesof shavua sheni vehu shemmasgiro o machlito o potro. met hakkohen sheraahu techilla o shechala roehu kohen acher veen hashsheni yachol letammeo befisyon sheen yodea im pasa im lo pasa ella rishon. veneeman kohen lomar nega ze pasa venega ze lo pasa. vesear lavan ze kadam et habbaheret o baheret zo kadma et sear lavan: 
Chalal pasul liriyyat negaim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 2)</small> "echad mibbanav hakkohanim" bichhunnatam. aval baale mumin kesherim liriyyat negaim uvilvad shello yihye suma vaafillu beachat meenav. vaafillu kohen shekkaha meor enav lo yire et hannegaim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 12)</small> "lechol mare ene hakkohen": 
En roin et hannegaim ella bayyom ben lehasegir ben lehachelit ben liftor. shehare bechol hainyan hu omer bayyom uvayyom. veen roin lo beshacharit velo ben haarbayim velo betoch habbayit velo bayyom hameunnan lefi shekkeha niret azza. velo batztzohorayim lefi sheazza niret keha. ematay roin otan beshaa reviit uvachamishit uvashsheminit uvatteshiit. ben nige adam ben nige begadim uvattim: 
Bechol yom roin et hannegaim chutz mishshabbat veyom tov. chal yom shevii shello lihyot beshabbat o beyom tov maavirin laachorav. veyesh baddavar lehakel ulehachmir. sheefshar sheyyihye beyom shabbat ze shehu yom harauy lirot tame ulemachar yelchu lahen simane tuma. veefshar sheyyihye tahor ulemachar yivvaldu lo simane tuma. veen danin oto ella bishat reiyyato leachar hashshabbat: 
Chatan shennira bo nega notnin lo kol shivat yeme hammishte. vechen im nira bivgadav o beveto en roin otan ad leachar hammishte. vechen baregel notnin lo kol yemot haregel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 36)</small> "vetzivva hakkohen ufinnu et habbayit" vegomer im himtina tora lidvar harshut shello yittammeu kelav kal vachomer lidvar mitzva: 
En masgirin velo machlitin velo potrin ella bayyom sheyyire bo battechilla o bashshevii o beyom shelosha asar bingaim shemmasgirin bahen shene shavuot. mippene sheyyom shevii ole leminyan shavua rishon uleminyan shavua sheni bechol hannegaim ben benige adam ben benige battim uvegadim:

Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 10:

Hattolesh simane tuma o shekkava et hammichya ad shello ba etzel kohen hare ze tahor. vechen im asa ken bime hesger hare ze tahor leachar yeme hesger. veim telashan achar shehuchlat bahen hare ze muchlat keshehaya veen lo tohora ad shettifrach hatztzaraat bechullo o ad shettitmaet bahareto mikkigris:

Vetumtum veanderoginus porea uforem veote al safam mippene shehu safek: 
Echad metzora musgar veachad metzora muchlat leinyan tuma. veen ben metzora musgar limtzora muchlat leinyan tuma ella peria uferima vetiglachat vetzipporim shehattahor mittoch hesger patur min hattiglachat umin hatztzipporim vehattahor mittoch hechlet chayyav bahen. aval tumat shenehen shava bechol davar: 
Hametzora av meavot hattumot metamme adam vechelim bemaggao uchele cheres baaviro umetamme adam bemassa umetamme mishkav umoshav afillu tachat even kezav uchezava shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 6)</small> "vechibbes begadav vetaher" mippi hashshemua lamdu shettaher milletamme mishkav umoshav. veechad hammusgar veachad hammuchlat bechol ellu: 
Chumra yetera yesh bimtzora shemmetamme beviato labbayit ben bime hechlet ben bime hesger. ketzad. nichnas labbayit nitma kol asher babbayit ben adam ben kelim af al pi shello naga bahen naasu rishon letuma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 46)</small> "michutz lammachane moshavo" ma hu tame af moshavo tame. haya omed tachat hailan veavar adam tahor tachat hailan nitma. haya hattahor omed tachat hailan veavar hametzora tachtav lo timmeahu veim amad nitma shehare naasa lo moshav. safek amad safek lo amad tahor. hichnis hametzora rosho verubbo labbayit nitma kol sheyyesh betocho. nichnas levet hakkeneset osin lo mechitztza gavoah asara tefachim urechava arba ammot al arba ammot venichnas rishon veyotze acharon. kede sheyyihye moshavo levaddo velo yaamod im haam beirbuv vitamme otam:

etz erez umitzvato sheyyihye arko amma veavyo kirvia kera mikkire hammitta. veezov sheen lo shem levavy kemo shebbearnu. en pachut mittefach. usheni tolaat mishkalo shekel. veim tiamo pesalo kitzviat
